articleTitle: A wireless mesh network based temperature monitoring system for blast furnaces
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Normally in wired temperature monitoring system for blast furnaces, analog signals of thermocouples will be transmitted to main control room by compensating wires in long distance, which brings severe problems such as high cost, low reliability and maintenance difficulty. This paper reports the design and implements of a wireless temperature monitoring system for blast furnaces based on Wireless Mesh Network(WMN). A WMN based on Wi-Fi was built to connect all the thermocouple data acquisition node which has more than one routing to the main control room. The prototype system has been performed a trial run in a blastfurnace for more than six months, achieving a good result with stable operation. This WMN-based temperature monitoring system, which has high throughput, low cost, self-healing, self-organizing, high reliability, and good real-time performance, is an ideal alternative to wired monitoring system.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of roller's calibration system in steel plant based on total station
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Roller system equipment is always wear-out and deviates from its original position, which leads to the change of its spatial relationship. Ulteriorly, it may also prompt a series of problems such as wrinkle, off-tracking, edge overflow or bad profile. According to the current situation above, we have designed and implemented a roller's calibration system based on total station. Firstly, the measuring scheme of scatter coordinates is devised; then by using the data processing algorithm, some significative parameters of single roller and the whole system will be figured out. The software of this calibration system is developed with C#. It manifests the deviation graphically to calibrate the spatial location of the roller system. As a result of plenty of field tests, it proves that by and large this calibration system has meant target needs and ensured the accuracy. It can help to improve the capacity, quality and efficiency after putting into practical production.

articleTitle: Roll estimation algorithm based on Sage-Husa adaptive Kalman filtering with rotation criteria
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the problem of increasing error caused by irresistible measuring noise in traditional EKF method within trajectory, a new solution of roll estimation for correction fuze, enlightened by axial output of gyro can be treated as rotation compensation for system noise, using SHAKF with rotation criteria is proposed. Firstly, based on the simulating comparison of estimation precision between traditional EKF and SHAKF methods, the result indicates that the roll measuring error of the new solution conspicuously lower than that of EKF's, the mean value of measuring error is 0.26deg and the variance of that is 0.97deg, that means the adaptivity offilter can follow the innovation to make estimated state convergence and eventually decreases the absolute error of roll angle. Furthermore, the new SHAKF algorithm is also verified by in-lab testing with MEMS three-axis turntable under an actually varying rotation setting, and the result shows that the estimation error always below 4.2degs in dynamic range changing from 30r/s to 1r/s.

articleTitle: A bandwidth in-sensitive low stall sparse matrix vector multiplication architecture on reconfigurable FPGA platform
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Sparse Matrix with dense Vector Multiplication (SpMxV) is a key computational kernel for most mathematical high performance computing problems. SpMxV implementation on FPGAs provides better performance but memory bandwidth limitations and pipeline stalling are still ongoing research concerns. This research proposes an FPGA optimized single bit stream column major sparse compression format that ensures decreased memory bandwidth and storage requirement. The architecture ensures low pipeline stalling by effectively performing 3 floating point operations per cycle per processing element. The proposed architecture is demonstrated with known benchmarks on ZYNQ-ZC702 FPGA. Result shows that on average our approach achieves compression ratios of 3.0 to 5.3 with respect to conventional CSR format. And peak compression ratio of 20.0 can be achieved for certain matrices used in our research. Low stall architecture proves 40 to 150% depreciation in stall cycles providing better overall efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on application of intelligent jamming based on spectrum sharing technique of signal
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Faced by ballistic missile defense system with increasingly better performance, how to develop new intelligent defense-penetration method based on current methods is an important problem to be solved urgently in current period. According to current weakness and capacity compositions of defense penetration by ballistic missile, from 3 basic characteristics of sharing spectrum by detection and jamming of ect, based on missile-borne integrated RF technique and spectrum sharing technique of intelligent jamming, this paper tries to employ software reconstruction method and integrated design to accomplish the intelligent jamming technique integrating battlefield situation awareness and threat signal reconnaissance & jamming. The active radar detection function is achieved by spectrum sharing technique, integrated awareness ability of battlefield situation. In the aspect of power, integrated aperture technique is employed to achieve high gain and wide coverage of antenna and increase equivalent radiation power. As for signal pattern, the shared signal of quasi-chaotic modulation for detection &jamming is important to achieve both detection &location (warning) and suppression/deception jamming at the same time. At assurance of the system function integrity, that enhanced each function of system and increase the countermeasure and destruction performance, so as to improve system combat effectiveness and increase success rate of defense-penetration.

articleTitle: Research and experimental validation of the method for barometric altimeter aid GPS in challenged environment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: GPS signal interruption can be result from shading of the antenna by buildings or mountains in challenged environment, therefore unable to accurately positioning. The positioning accuracy in the vertical direction is often challenged in comparison with the one in the horizontal plane. Additional barometric altimeter are therefore used to overcome the above effects and enhance availability and accuracy. This paper explores the possibility of using barometric altimeter as an augmentation GPS in challenged environment, with analysis of the characteristics of the barometric altimeter and optimize the calibration method. A prototype system, composed of a commercial GPS receiver with barometric altimeter, is implemented and described. In addition, the preliminary investigation of the barometric altimeter is addressed. With the field experimental data collected from a car-driving test in a hilly region, the benefit of barometric altimeter aiding is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A SEU test and simulation method for Zynq BRAM and flip-flops
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Zynq is designed to provide higher overall system performance and programmable flexibility at lower power consumption, which is consistent with the trend of commercial small satellite computers. Although modern commercial Zynq chips offer those aforementioned advantages, On-Chip Block RAM(BRAM) and flip-flops(FF) are susceptible to Single Event Upsets(SEU) in space application. We proposed built-in self-test circuits to test the SEU cross sections of BRAM and FF based on the analysis of the basic structure and application requirements of Zynq. To verify the validity of the self-test circuits, the fault injectors are designed to simulate the SEU at any position in any BRAM and each FF. The design can be used for space-borne and ground heavy ion test of Zynq chips.

articleTitle: A passive MMW radiometric image feature extraction for security inspection
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For application of security inspection, the passive millimeter wave (MMW) radiometric transferring model is presented in the indoor experiments. A simulation imaging experiment to the human body with concealed metal objects was done by using 3mm waveband alternating current radiometer. A feature extraction method for millimeter wave radiometric image is also proposed based on morphology and contour method. The results show that the contour processing method can overcome the disadvantage of untrue edge phenomenon in traditional differential edge extraction method and the features extracted of objects are more conformed to the geometrical characteristics of concealed metals.

articleTitle: The research of performance testing about watt-hour meter plug
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the important part of new low-voltage metering cabinet, the performance of watt-hour meter plug influences directly the convenience of operation, the stability of smart meter running and the reliability of metering cabinet. For lacking of the uniform technical specification and an effective, reliably and fast testing method for the performance of plug, this paper proposes a new testing method, it includes the important index of insertion and extraction power and temperature rise. The testing results shows that the method of this paper proposed can detect the mechanical and technical parameters accurately and conveniently, it provides reference for the stability and reliability of metering cabinet.

articleTitle: Research on optimized control of braking force redistribution
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: An high-performance approach for the optimized control of braking force redistribution is presented in the paper since serious sliding problem will be caused when the braking force of the electric-multiple-unit (EMU) exceeds the adhesion limit. The maximum adhesion, i.e. the adhesion limit is calculated first for each train through the analysis on the brake system of EMU. The total braking force required to be applied respectively on the motor vehicle and the trailer is obtained in consideration of the constraint of the braking force applied by the maximum adhesion in the distribution strategy of the electrical braking control model in priority. Then, the total braking force of the motor vehicle and the trailer is re-distributed in proportional to the maximum adhesion to obtain the braking force should be applied on each train. The higher the adhesion limit is, the larger the braking force applied on the train. Higher superiority of the approach for optimized control of braking force redistribution proposed in the paper is demonstrated by the simulation and analysis on the approach using simulation software.

articleTitle: Development of airborne distributed analog data acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Flight testing is a necessary procession which gathers information and data from the airplane when flying. The airborne distributed analog data acquisition system is used to collect, store and display the analog data of the airplane in the flight test, which provide data support for further aircraft state estimating, performance test and fault diagnosis. The essence of it is a wild-distributed data acquisition system which gathers large numbers of analog parameters with high time synchronization accuracy Traditional airborne data acquisition system is based on PCM architecture which has advantages in system time synchronization stability, however, as planes become more sophisticated, a large number of parameters with a wild spatial distribution needs to be collected, the routing needs to be more concise as long as the time synchronization accuracy is highly demanded. As a result, the existing PCM architecture may not fully meets the requirements of the latest flight test. In this paper a hierarchical distributed airborne analog data acquisition system is designed and developed. In order to enhance the system expansibility and achieve high bandwidth, an easy-routing distributed architecture which combines Ethernet with the RS-485 bus was proposed. A RS-485 frame based time synchronization is applied to achieve high time synchronization accuracy. It is verifiable that the developed prototype can synchronously collect analog signals under high time synchronization accuracy, which fully meet the requirements of China self-developed large airplane and boost the development of China aviation industry.

articleTitle: Design of broadband millimeter sum-difference network
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Sum-difference network is used as an important device for millimeter radar and electronic countermeasures system, this paper proposes a kind of design plan based on 90°coupling bridge and waveguide space transition planar sum-difference network, and utilize ADS & HFSS software to simulate and optimize design model to get a compact sum-difference network design circuit. By means of micro-package technology and wave guide shell processing accuracy control, creates two-way comparator object which dimension is 50mm × 25mm × 15mm, and analyzes the effects of port matching on design. Test result indicates that the two-way sum-difference network has the advantage of easy structure, good port amplitude consistency, low standing waves etc. meets direction finding demand which is based on phased array millimeter radar/ electronic countermeasures system.

articleTitle: Evaluation method on use and maintenance test of armored equipment in coastal environment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In my country, length of land coastline exceeds 18000 km and islands scatter in the sea, so coastal environment is typical operational environment. Characteristic of coastal environment is humid, hot and has a long rainy season, salt atmosphere and moulds also influence armored equipment. In this paper, deep analyzes performances influence of armored equipment in coastal environment, constructs indexes system of use and maintenance test in coastal environment, establishes evaluation model based on AHP, ADC and Fuzzy theory synthesis, availably realizes quantitative evaluation of use and maintenance of armored equipment in coastal environment.

articleTitle: Research on the hardware co-processing technology for waveform character searching with a digital oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Waveform character Searching is one of the important means for a digital oscilloscope to capture and analyze signals of interest, and also marks the waveform analysis capability of the digital oscilloscope. Its performance determines the design level of the oscilloscope directly. At present, domestic digital oscilloscopes generally show low efficiency in waveform character Searching. For this reason, a research on the FPGA+DSP-based waveform character Searching hardware co-processing technology was conducted. Details on the operating principle and design method were given, and comparative analyses were performed on software and hardware-based Searching efficiency. The results of simulation and testing indicate that this method can effectively improve the real-time processing capability of an oscilloscope.

articleTitle: The bus-bar net load forecasting based on ARIMA and PSR-BPNN
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to realize the real-time tracking and forecasting of net load with distributed power bus, a method based on autoregressive moving average (ARIMA) and phase space reconstruction back-propagation neural network (PSR-BPNN) is proposed. Inherent linear and nonlinear components of the net load are considered to increase forecasting accuracy. This method can be divided into three steps: firstly, ARIMA is adapted to forecast the linear components of net load using the historical data; secondly, C-C method is used to reconstruct the nonlinear components; thirdly, the BP neural network forecasting model is established based on the reconstructed series. According to the analysis of forecasting results, the proposed ARIMA and PSR-BPNN forecasting model is more suitable for the net load with distributed PV components.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent car control system based on new energy
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces a new energy intelligent vehicle system design on the basis of Arduino by WIFI remote control. The solar energy collection device with dual-axis automatic tracking system can achieve real-time tracking of silicon solar cell panels in the direction of strongest sunlight. It is an efficient method of luminous energy collection. The whole system is low-cost, it is easier to implement.

articleTitle: Harris feature and coherent point drift based remote sensing image registration
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Non-rigid point-set registration based image registration is a technology frequently used in image retrieval, stereo matching and the analysis of satellite and medical images. In remote sense image analysis, Harris corner detection is often chosen as an ideal approach of feature extraction. The method we propose utilizes the feature metric produced by Harris corner detection, which is not employed in current methods, and integrate it into the Coherent Point Drift framework to enhance accuracy. We first construct a likelihood descriptor of point-to-point correspondence, then this likelihood value is used as a prior probability term in the Gaussian mixture model. Finally, we use the Expectation Maximization algorithm to iteratively match the points. Our contribution includes finding a way of normalizing the feature metric data and constructing a proper descriptor to incorporate the Harris feature metric and the Euclidean distance which can minimize the negative effects of the deviations in the feature metric values. Experiments are conducted upon remote sense images, compared against four state-of-the-art image registration algorithms, including two non-iterative methods and two iterative methods, where our method show the smallest error rate and the best registered image result.

articleTitle: Real-time blind calibration for frequency response mismatches in two-channel TI-ADCs
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces a real-time blind calibration algorithm for frequency response mismatch in two-channel time-interleaved(TI) ADCs. By adding an offset calibration algorithm before frequency response calibration algorithm, we can compensate offset, gain, timing and bandwidth mismatches. The offset calibration algorithm is low complexity and very efficient, which consume only several adders. In addition, we replace FxLMS with Signed-FxLMS to reduce resource consumption and improve clocking performance. In order to achieve superior clocking performance, the whole algorithm is designed to a full-pipelined form. Finally, we demonstrate the efficiency of the calibration algorithm by XILINXISIM.

articleTitle: Analysis for propagation characteristics of longitudinal mode and torsional mode guided waves in rod
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Regarding the application of guided waves in one-dimensional structure, the propagation characteristics of the longitudinal guided wave and torsional guided wave are investigated. The dispersion equations of guided wave in the longitudinal and torsional modes in one-dimensional component are derived. Through programming numerical calculation in MATLAB, the frequency dispersion curves of the two modes are obtained, which imply that the engineering application of guided waves in detection of rod needs to choose an appropriate frequency and the corresponding propagation characteristics of the waves should be combined to get reliable results. The dispersion characteristics analysis results in different radius of rods show that it is feasible for detecting the defects in rod using L(0,1) mode of ultrasonic guided waves.

articleTitle: The impact of multipath effect on jamming of active decoy outboard
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Multipath effect of sea surface has an impact on jamming of active decoy outboard. Firstly, the model of multipath effect of sea surface has been determined. Study of multipath effect is based on the simplest model of mirror reflection, in which it is assumed that mirror target is just below real target and that flat ground surface achieves good electrical conductivity. In the case of mirror reflection, it can be solved by studying the relation with reflection of flat ground surface. Secondly, CCIR mathematical model of active jamming under multipath effect has been presented. Plural permittivity of electromagnetism characteristic and reflection characteristic over the ocean are researched. Varying rule of the seawater relative Permittivity, the sea water conductivity, reflection coefficient over slick offing and modified factor over crude offing are analyzed through stimulation. Sea state is used as wave height partitioning adopted by Douglas. Main factor that influence their change is gained. Lastly, impact of multipath effect on active decoy jamming under typical conditions has been analyzed by simulation. It is pointed out that under high level of sea state when roughness of sea surface increases multipath effect will decrease, while under low level of sea state when roughness of sea surface decreases multipath effect will increase. Also when height of active decoy jamming outboard increases energy fluctuation of jamming signal will decrease.

articleTitle: A multi-channel sub-nyquist sampling method based on spectrum co-prime permutation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate sub-Nyquist sampling method, which can work at the sampling rate below the Nyquist rate. Nowadays, the sampling rate of the classical sub-Nyquist sampling is higher than discrete Compressed Sensing (CS), since the sparseness of the original signal is always destroyed by basis mismatch. We propose a new multi-channel co-prime sampling system along with Sparse Fourier Transform. The analog signal of each channel is firstly mixed by a series of exponential functions. Then, it is fed into integrators and commercial analog-to-digital converters (ADCs). It is noted that the frequency parameters of each subsystem are co-prime. Chinese remainder theorem (CRT) is utilized for the joint processing of all sets of samples and the reconstruction of original signals. Finally, the effects of the signal sparsity, the sampling rate and the signal to noise ratio are simulated in this system. In addition, the experimental results show that the proposed system can work at the rate lower than Random Demodulation RD), Modulated wideband converter (MWC) and their improved version.

articleTitle: Design of blade monitoring system for wind turbine generator
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the influence of the complexity of the wind power generator on the blade in the natural environment, the gyroscope and the barometric altimeter are used to design the monitoring system to realize the monitoring of the running state and environment of the fan in the operation of the large wind turbine. The system is composed of two gyroscope pressure altimeter sensors module and a main control module, and the data is processed by the ARM cortex-m0 kernel microcontroller. MPU6050 gyroscope sensor module USES, in view of the characteristics of the MEMS devices which are caused by the low precision and data of problem, through adaptive Kalman filter for data processing, to improve its robustness. The measuring system adopts modular design and improves the anti-interference performance during dynamic measurement. The experimental results show that the system of the design is fast in response to the Angle and pressure height, and the Angle measurement parameters are large, and the measuring precision is high.

articleTitle: The application of AMR sensor in the magnetic object detection and localization
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The magnetic object localization is widely utilized in sea mine detection, identification of vehicles and unexploded ordnance. And the Anisotropic Magneto-resistive (AMR) sensor is applied in compassing, navigation systems, and magnetometer. Thus, a novel magnetic object localization method based on AMR sensor is presented in this paper. Firstly magnetic object localization theoretical model is established, and magnetic field and magnetic gradient need to be measured for localization. And then detection and localization hardware construction is designed and realized. The weak magnetic field detection method and measurement modules are discussed. At last, the lab test based on AMR sensor is carried out. The results show that it is an effective method for magnetic object localization and when the magnet of surface magnetic field is 0.9T, the location error is not more than 10% from 50cm to 140cm. AMR sensor is a valuable choice for magnetic object localization measurement.

articleTitle: Fabrication and calibration of Pt/Au thin-film thermocouple based on a modified screen printing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The purpose of the current study is to find a low-cost and rapid-fabrication approach for producing Thin-film thermocouples (TFTCs) with different junction thicknesses. Nowadays, the popular TFTC fabrication methods are usually based on physical vapour deposition technology. They are high time cost and poor economy. In order to improve the production efficiency, a modified screen printing technology which is combining with wet grinding technology was employed in this article. First, the uniform thickness Pt/Au TFTCs were fabricated based on the regular screen printing technology. Then, the different junction thickness TFTCs were obtained through polished by an automatic high precision lapping machine. With this step, the junction thickness of TFTC is no longer limited to the viscosity and fineness of the ink in the present method. Through the calibration experiments, the static and dynamic performance of the fabricated Pt/Au TFTCs were estimated. The results show that the Seebeck coefficient of these TFTCs have no significant degradation compared with wire-style thermocouples in the temperature from 50 °C to 620 °C. The repeatability and consistency of these TFTCs are satisfying the requirements of the wire-style thermocouples. The pulse laser heating experiments results show the response time constant of these TFTCs are less than 12.33 μS. Compared with other screen-printed TFTCs, the Pt/Au TFTC presented in this study has a wider temperature measurement range. This implied that this rapidly and economically fabricated TFTCs can satisfy the requirements in many transient surface temperature measurement applications.

articleTitle: A memory-logic separated 3D chip physical design method
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: 3D IC is developing rapidly, but there is no mature physical design. A 3D chip physical design method contains hierarchical process, memory and TSV localization process, as well as hierarchical physical design process is proposed in this paper. By splitting the netlist, memory and logic are layered up and down. And the upper memories and TSV cells are placed automatically by implemented the localization algorithm. Each layer can be routed separately. It is concluded that this physical design method is feasible and the processes can be compatible in 2D EDA tools.

articleTitle: Classification of marine noise signals based on DNN (Deep Neural Networks) model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of different marine noise signals' classification, a multi-layer neuron networks model, which can be used to learn and analyze different marine noise signals, is built based on DNN (Deep Neural Networks) model in this article. Firstly, let's generate the initialized weight value randomly. Secondly, do linear operation that the input values of each layer multiply the weight values and then add the figures together. Thirdly, function value normalization is achieved by implementing nonlinear sigmoid active function, and we can get error function of actual output and desired output. Fourthly, we can get error coefficient of weight value and minimal value by gradient descent algorithm. In the last, we can get classification weight value which can distinguish different marine noise signals by summing this coefficient and weight value to keep weigh value updated. In the article, a four-layer deep neuron networks is built, of which three layers are hidden. Train the matrix data, test it and the result is that there are four errors among 100 test objects with 94%o accuracy. At the same time, the average accuracy of the 10 test results was 91.7%. It proves that this method can achieve the marine noise signals' classification.

articleTitle: Airborne sensor management algorithm based on targets threat evaluation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Airborne sensor management is an important technical to improve sensors detection efficiency. This article proposed an algorithm based on targets threat evaluation to solve the airborne multi-sensory face to multi-target problem. The fuzzy optimization theory and analytic hierarchy process are used to evaluate the threat of multiple targets. The sensor management performance function is established according to target threat degree and detection precision, then the sensor management is completed according to the filtering algorithm and the optimization theory. Simulation results shown that the proposed algorithm makes the airborne sensor management more reasonable and provides a basis for commander's combat decision.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation of on — Line wear debris monitoring sensor based on JMAG
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the wear debris sensor in the wear debris on - line monitoring system, the variation of the magnetic field distribution and the induced voltage of the induction coil in the working state is simulated. Taking into account the coil material, turns and excitation coil excitation power supply voltage, frequency and other factors. The three - dimensional finite element model of sensor coil structure was established by JMAG Designer software. The simulation results reveal the influence of different turns, power supply and so on in the internal magnetic field distribution and the voltage in the induction coil. The related conclusions have certain guiding significance to the design parameters of such sensor structure, which is of great value to the development of wear debris on-line monitoring system.

articleTitle: Judicial expertise of speaker identity based on improved pitch algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on the comprehensive analysis and comparison in the characteristic of acoustics between the sample speaker and the case sample speaker, we can get the identification of identity. The identification can be used in many cases like providing clues, directions and ranges to investigate and solve a case. In addition, it can also provide independent evidence for litigation. As one of the main features of speaker, fundamental frequency curve plays an important role in the identification of identity. In this passage, we create an improved pitch period extraction algorithm based on the traditional way of detection method of pitch period. This experiment has proved that the method in this passage works more accurately than the traditional way in the noise circumstance and it can provide more convincing evidence for judicial expertise.

articleTitle: Decoupled Kalman filter based on SINS/GPS integrated navigation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The Kalman Filter of Strapdown Inertial Navigation System/Global Positioning System (SINS/GPS) Integration Navigation that overcomes each individual system's shortcomings and is widely used in UAV systems. The computation time depends mainly on the filter dimension n, the low dimension benefit real time but influence the system accuracy. However, with dimensions increasing, the system computation will become complicity and insecure. The decoupled Kalman filter can obtain high precision with real-time working performance by decoupling error state. The detailed process of decoupling is described in this paper. And comparison analysis of common filter and decoupled one will be explained from both theoretical and practical aspects. The simulation results show the feasibility of the new method which solves above problems and reduces memory space to make UAV system possess extensible functionality. So it can be widely used in UAV system to further improve it's overall performance.

articleTitle: Research on non-contact measurement method of ball screw nut based on spectral confocal principle
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The ball screw nut is the key component in the ball screw pair. Because of its complex inner structure and small hole size, it is difficult to measure machined accuracy of the ball screw nut. A non-contact measurement method of the ball screw nut based on spectral confocal principle is presented. The measurement space of the cylindrical coordinate of the nut is established according to its structure features. The inner cavity is scanned by dividing the section layer by layer to obtain the three-dimensional point-cloud data of the inner surface. Through transferring measurement space of the cylindrical coordinate into the calculation space of the rectangular coordinate the structure parameters of the inner groove of the ball screw nut are calculated, including pitch, inner diameter, pitch diameter, median runout and lead angle. The chord height difference method is used to denoise and filter the measurement data to get the more actual measured data. The three-dimensional reconstruction of the nut cavity structure is carried out using reverse technology to display the processed textures. The feasibility and effectiveness of the method is verified by the measurement experiment of ball screw nut. The experimental results show that the measurement method proposed in this paper can effectively check the ball screw nut with the high measurement accuracy, and has the ability of wide measurement range, and good expansion.

articleTitle: Design and numerical simulation of multi direction jet flow generator
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, we reported the design and numerical simulation of multi direction jet flow generator with disc shaped multi circular airflow channel. Using the finite element analysis method, the COMSOL Multiphysics software was used to calculate the airflow field distribution and motion feature inside of the generator. Calculation and results indicated that: (1) There is an integrated, steadily cycled and directional flow inside of this device. (2) This generator produced four directional flow comprising two perpendicular pairs of flow and generated four orthometric distributed jet flow inside of sensing chamber. (3) The airflow velocity at pump chamber nozzle and sensing chamber nozzle are 20.84m/s, 12.52m/s, respectively. The velocity at the two nozzles are much higher than other part inside of the channel. The mentioned multi direction jet flow generator can be used in multi axis jet flow inertia sensor, micro fluid system and lab-on-chip and so on studying field.

articleTitle: Quantum-cascade laser absorption spectroscopy based on-line SF6 decomposed gases monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the field of high-voltage electric equipments, the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas as insulation material is widely used in various kinds of Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS). And the decomposition of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas under discharge would generates various kinds of gases, which may seriously result in worse insulation performance of the high-voltage electric power equipment. Thus, it is an urgent issue to monitoring these gases. However, existing inspection methods still fail to conduct on-line monitoring of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposed gases. Aimed to solve this problem, this paper proposes an On-line SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposed gases monitoring approach based on the Quantum-Cascade Laser Absorption Spectroscopy. In this system, the composition and the concentration of each kind of gas can be obtained by testing the absorption peak value and absorption intensity of the wavelength. Experiment results show that the proposed system is able to perform on-line monitoring of SF6 decomposed gases with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of photovoltaic power attenuation rate under thehaze weather based on multi-factor fitting model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the light of frequent occurrence of haze weather, the output power of photovoltaic panel is dramatically affected. In order to accurately predict the output power of photovoltaic power generation under the haze weather, in this paper, the research status of the output performance of photovoltaic modules is firstly investigated, then the correlations between various factors and the output power attenuation rate of photovoltaic panel are analyzed, and multi-factor fitting method is adopted to establish the prediction model of photovoltaic power attenuation rate. The experimental results show that the proposed prediction model has high precision.

articleTitle: Non-destructive testing of one-dimensional structure based on time reversal
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: We divided the structure into a number of planes through the center shaft for the nondestructive damage detection of one dimensional structure. Taking two planes as represented while one contains defect and the other perpendicular to it in order to solve the problem of signal sensor. One multi-path propagation model is established, and one non-destructive test (NDT) method, which is based upon time reversal (TR) algorithm and multi-path, is structured. From the amplitudes and time delays of stress wave along different paths to the damage, we calculated one transfer function and testify the practicability of TR algorithm for NDT of one dimensional structure. From the experimental analysis we can see that TR algorithm can be used well at NDT in order to suppress the multi-path effect and noise, meanwhile, focusing the damage signal of the structure.

articleTitle: Intelligent car platform for swarm algorithm verification
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As an important part of artificial intelligence, swarm algorithm is mostly verified by theoretical simulation. In this paper, such swarm behavior is verified by intelligent cars. The hardware design includes intelligent car network module, speed measurement module, electronic compass module and motor module, etc. The software part includes control program of each module and swarm algorithm. Based on the intelligent car's swarm algorithm, this paper designs a suitable platform of intelligent car for verification. Finally completes the design and algorithm verification of the intelligent car successfully.

articleTitle: Radial simulation research of gas-solid two phase annular flow with ultrasonic fluid measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As for its application and universality, the research of gas-solid two-phase flow becomes popular, and annular flow is one of the common flow. By COMSOL software, radial simulation models are set up to study the different annular flow. It is simulated with different parameter annular flow and different frequency of ultrasonic, to research the sensitivity in diverse gas-solid flow. And also, the signals received by the ultrasonic sensor in different annular flow and frequency are analyzed. Thus, it offers theory analysis for diverse gas-solid two phase flow in the ultrasonic method.

articleTitle: Applications research of sigma-delta modulator in high precision measurement system of motor current
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Sigma-Delta AD conversion technology is widely used in high resolution applications, especially in high signal integrity and current isolation in AC motor current measurement system. The research proposes a Sigma-Delta AD conversion design for AC motor current measurement system. The research proposes a Sigma-Delta AD conversion design for AC motor current measurement system. The design can demodulate and filter the AD conversion signal, and the Sinc<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> digital decimation filter is adopted to demodulate it by means of filtering and decimation. The Sinc<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> digital decimation filter is designed by FPGA. It realizes the high-frequency filtering of output signal of the Sigma-Delta modulator and achieves high precision isolation sampling of motor current and meets the requirements of sampling accuracy and response speed of AC motor current measurement.

articleTitle: Compensation for magnetic moment measurement error of dynamic loop method
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Dynamic loop method is a magnetic moment measurement method using eccentric magnetic dipole model, which can calculate the dipole magnetic moment values and position of the target object through the magnetic flux generated by the object. If the magnetic flux is not compensated, the measurement error is very large. Based on the analysis of the sources and characteristics of the instrument error, equipment error and random error of dynamic loop method prototype, three kinds of error compensation models are proposed, and the solving method of the model parameters is given. The test results show that the error compensation model can effectively correct the magnetic flux measurement value and improve the accuracy of dipole magnetic moment measurement. When the fluctuation amplitude of the ambient magnetic field is less than 10nT, the measurement error of the dipole magnetic moment is less than 10% ± 50mA · m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. This error compensation method can be applied to the dynamic loop method magnetic moment measurement, and it can effectively improve the measurement accuracy.

articleTitle: Ferrographic analysis in wear fault diagnosis for the confluent planetary gear mechanism
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The principle of ferrography, the method of preparing sample and the procedure of ferrography analysis were introduced. The main morphology characteristics of abrasive in the abnormal wear stage of the confluent planetary gear mechanism were analyzed. It could be found that the fault predicted by the identification and analysis of the abrasive particles image of the oil was coincided with the fault of actual disassembly and assembly detection. That could be good for extending the application of ferrography in fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on infrared communication detection system of smart electricity meter
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the detection of smart electricity meter infrared communication performance and function, this paper designs a detection system for smart electricity meter infrared communication. The system builds a process of automatic reading and parsing detection information. the system core is composed of the Infrared transceiver circuit, MCU control unit, simulation of natural light unit and a cryptographic management unit. An automatic detection model of infrared carrier center frequency based on an multi-multi-cycle synchronization frequency measurement is developed. Closed loop control technology is adopted to realize the simulation of natural light and automatic detection of natural light resistance. A cryptographic management system model based on the SM1 cryptographic algorithm is built and the infrared authentication is carried out. The detection results show that the detection method can effectively find existing smart meter infrared communication abnormality, make up the previous quality management loopholes, guarantee the quality of installation and operation of the smart meter, improve the management level and work efficiency.

articleTitle: Determination of free-air chamber correction factors for electron loss, photon scatter and fluorescence using EGSnrc
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Mammography x-rays standard is basis of improving the quality of mammary machine and reduce the radiation dose of women and medical staff. The molybdenum target x-rays machine is used as the radiation source, and free-air chamber is designed for detecting photons. Refer to international standards file four standard radiation qualities are established. The spectrum of the four radiation qualities are simulated using EGSnrc, which are used as the source in the calculation of correction factors. The free-air correction factors for electron loss, photon scatter and fluorescence are calculated using the Monte Carlo simulation software EGSnrc. The calculation results are compared with other national metrology institute, the deviation is within 0.53%.

articleTitle: Design of acquisition system with real time sampling rate of 5Gsps
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With development of digital signal processing, the bandwidth of underlying signal becomes broader. It requires that the acquisition system must be with high sampling rate. In this paper, we propose a design of high-speed acquisition system, which is with real time sampling rate of 5Gsps and mass storage based on PCI extension for instrument (PXI) bus. The system sampler uses multi-core analog-to-digital converter (ADC) parallel sampling and combines accurate sampling clock to have enough effective bits under the premise of ensuring high real-time sampling rate. Using Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) to collect high-speed samples from ADC. In FPGA, serial to parallel module decreases the data rate. In order to improve the capability of capturing transient signals, the trigger detection unit is designed to control the storage operation. In addition, the design of mass data storage enhances the ability of data acquisition system to capture high speed signals. Consequently, improve the detail analysis ability of the system. The designed system has been tested with satisfactory results.

articleTitle: Calibration for time domain reflectometry modular in digital communication analyzer
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the clock frequency and data rate of digital circuit become much higher, signal integrity has become increasingly important. Impedance mismatch of signal transmission paths can cause signal reflection, decrease the signal quality, so the impedance in the signal transmission paths needs to be understood and controlled. During impedance measurements, the preferred method is time domain reflectometry (TDR), which uses high performance digital communication analyzer equipped with TDR modules. A lot of digital communication analyzers equipped with TDR modules in those enterprises need to be calibrated, sent to Shanghai Institute of measurement and testing technology every year. But so far, relevant verification regulation or calibration specification of TDR module has not issued domestic. In order to meet the calibration requirements of our customers, combined with our many years of experience in pulse parameters calibration, carefully studying the technical specifications of TDR module produced by Tektronix, Inc. and Agilent technologies, making full use of the standard instruments in our pulse parameter laboratory, we calibrate the TDR module of digital communication analyzer and meet requirements of customers.

articleTitle: Covariance matrix denoising based direction of arrive estimation for spherical array with atomic norm minimization
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A covariance matrix denoising based Direction-of-arrive (DOA) estimation approach for spherical array is developed in this paper. Firstly, based on the spherical phase mode transformation, a spherical harmonic (SH) domain covariance matrix model of the spherical array is presented as multiple measurement vectors, where the atomic norm minimization approach is extended to SH domain and is applied for covariance matrix denoising. Then the spherical ESPRIT method is used to DOA estimation. Unlike the conventional approaches, the proposed method not only requires no prior knowledge of the noise statistic property, but also has the capability of dealing with the coherent signals. Simulations show the out performance of out method compared with the conventional ones.

articleTitle: Study of calibration of three-axis fluxgate magnetometers on unmanned helicopter
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aeromagnetic exploration is one of the most important exploration methods in geophysics. In aeromagnetic exploration, three-axis fluxgate magnetometers are widely used to measure the attitude of the platform. However, system error caused by the manufacture precision of three-axis fluxgate magnetometers degrades the measurement accuracy of the attitude. Therefore, the calibration of three-axis fluxgate magnetometers is essential. In this paper, the calibration model of three-axis fluxgate magnetometers is discussed, and the measurement errors of three-axis fluxgate magnetometers in an unmanned helicopter experiment are analyzed. A calibration method is applied to the inflight data. Then, more accurate attitude of the platform is obtained. The validity of the method is demonstrated by the experimental results.

articleTitle: Study on enhancing features of digital oscilloscope to analyze the envelope of signal
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The novel digital storage oscilloscopes provides the abundant digital signal processing and analysis functions, including envelope analysis which plays a significant role in anomaly detection and fault diagnosis. In this paper, envelope analysis based on a modified multiscale-based peak detection method is proposed. Firstly, a waveform database is built by use of the 3D waveform mapping technology; and then, the envelope waveforms are computed. The results are displayed on the screen according to the predefined envelope waveform intensity, with the envelope waveform updated in real time according to the variable envelope persistence parameter set by the user. The simulation and experiment demonstrates that this method can improve the test efficiency and lower the test cost.

articleTitle: Research on gearbox fault diagnosis method based on DTCWT and order spectrum
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Because the gear boxes of large wind turbine unit operate under complicated working conditions in a long-term, the vibration signals collected from the gearbox are subjected to a large amount of background noise. In order to effectively extract fault features from vibration signals, the heuristic soft threshold and dual tree complex wavelet transform were adopted to denoise the collected signals. Then, according to the speed pulse signal collected synchronously, the rotating shaft frequency and the gear fitting frequency were calculated by time measuring method, and the same frequency sine data was generated, and then the correlation between the sine data and the vibration data was calculated to judge the fault location preliminarily. Lastly, the three order equation fitting method was used to carry out order resampling, and the power spectrum of the order data was calculated to obtain the gear fault feature. The simulation of Matlab and experiment results show that this method is effective in fault diagnosis feature extraction for wind turbine gearbox.

articleTitle: The application of GC/MS in spacecraft pollution control
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In recently years, the problems of spacecrafts contamination occur sequentially, which can result in sensitive spacecraft's hardware out of work. The chief reason of contamination is vacuum outgassing of non-materials. The gray cable is used widely in spacecrafts. When the gray cable locates in vacuum environment, it can release gases inevitable, which form contamination film once deposited on sensitive surfaces. For avoiding the similar problems happened on other spacecrafts, it is very necessary to study the vacuum outgassing characteristics of the gray cable and preprocess before using it. The vacuum outgassing characteristics of the gray cable are studied in this paper for the first time. First, total mass loss (TML) and collected volatile condensable materials (CVCM) of gray cable are obtained after outgassing experiments for 24 hours. Then, the variety between TML and outgassing time is studied in this paper, too. At last, the components of outgassing products are also provided in different temperature. The results show that TML of gray cable is 1.2%o even at a lower temperature of 65 °C. There is sharply increase of TML in first 24 hours, and gently increase after 24 hours. In addition, the main components of outgassing products indicate that they are different in different temperatures, which are phthalates at a temperature of 65 °C and are siloxanes at temperatures of 85 °C and 105 °C. The results can assist to directing the use and improvement of gray cable. It can also provide advantage proof for setting vacuum bake-out parameters of gray cable.

articleTitle: A fault-tolerant program memory unit for on-board computer
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The program memory of the on-board computer for satellite is susceptible to the space radiation effect. In order to overcome this problem, a reliable strategy to comprise a storage unit with NOR Flash was proposed for space application. And a fault-tolerant approach based on triple modular redundancy (TMR) was employed to correct the error by radiation effect. Meanwhile, several backup partitions were designed in the single-chip flash to further enhance the fault-tolerant ability of on-board computer. Another obstacle for TMR program memory system is how to download the program into each chip or partition on board with one download interface. A TMR-Switch program downloading method was proposed to overcome it by setting download data path and controlling memory partitions. Experiments on three NOR Flash chips and ZYNQ processor was conducted, and the results showed great capability in correcting faults in the onboard computer program file.

articleTitle: Radiating frequency character of dipole antenna with EBG board as a reflector
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The frequency character of dipole antenna loading with EBG board is discussed. The EBG reflector is set behind the dipole antenna as a reflector board. For the coupling between the antenna and the EBG reflector the radiating frequency would shift compared to the isolated dipole. The paper focuses on the radiating frequency character of the antenna system. Simulations were implemented. The simulation results indicated that the image part of the antenna system is zero at radiating frequency, which means the EBG structure and the dipole system is in resonance state. When the distance between antenna and the EBG reflector changed the radiating frequency changed also. With the distance increasing the radiating frequency changed nonlinearly and the value has the decreasing tendency.

articleTitle: The development of differential programmable josephson voltage standard toward quantum voltmeter with microvolt range
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a differential programmable Josephson voltage standard developed at NIM. By the means of a Josephson voltage compensated by the other, the differential programmable Josephson voltage standard can be used as a high-precision ultra low-voltage standard to calibrate the microvolt ranges of nanovoltmeters. And based on it, we will develop the quantum voltmeter which is able to cover DC voltage from 0 V to 10 V, to complete DVM calibration in all the ranges. The measurement results show the difference between the measurement and the nominal value of 1 microvolt is -0.17 nV, with the relative standard deviation of 1.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. The measurement and uncertainty analysis has certified the standard shows satisfactory reliability and stability. In addition, the double channel array also has been developed to simplify the differential system.

articleTitle: Research on the trend prediction method of equipment operation stability based on quantification interval of deterioration degree
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Operation of the wind turbine is influenced by ever-changing wind speed and wind direction, and its transmission system running in a state of nonlinear and non-stationary operation. It is difficult and inaccurate to predict the amplitude of the vibration of the transmission system in real time. So the method, the trend prediction method of deterioration about equipment operation stability based on the degree of deterioration and quantification interval, is proposed in this paper. The vibration signal of the running state would be collected about the transmission system of the wind turbine; the concept, “the mean value of 1.5 dimensional spectral band energy”, is proposed. According to the concept of “the mean value of 1.5 dimension spectrum frequency band energy”, corresponding classification standard of vibration signal is established, and the degradation degree of running stability is quantified to obtain the quantification interval about the degree of deterioration. Then the state sequence of deterioration of the operation stability is established. The known observation sequence is predicted about tendency by using the improved superimposed Markov chain prediction method. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, measured vibration data experiment would be used to do verification test about the windfield wind turbine generator in working condition. The experimental results show that the development trend of the deterioration state could be got though the running stability deterioration trend prediction, which is consistent with the actual running state.

articleTitle: A gas flowrate calibration facility with adjustable pressure and temperature
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on master meter principle, a gas flowrate calibration facility with adjustable pressure and temperature is designed. The working principle and structure of this facility is detailly introduced. The calibration method of gas flowmeters is given and the uncertainty is evaluated. With this facility, the gas pressure and temperature can be continuously adjusted, to simulate the practical working pressure and temperature of the tested flowmeter. Therefore, it is suitable for calibrating gas flowmeters, especially those working under high pressure and high temperature conditions. Experimental results show that he proposed facility is effective in calibrating vortex flowmeter at different pressure and temperature.

articleTitle: Analysis of exhaustive service and gated service improved polling system based on Anylogic
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a exhaustive-gated mixed service polling model which provides a better fairness and small delay in the scene of data brust. In the presented model, the serve selects exhaustive service(ES) and gated service(GS) with probability. GS can consider fairness of the system, while ES can solve the problem of data brust. Given the fact that traditional numerical analysis do bad in analyzing this model accurately. The simulation model is established in Anylogic. The experimental results indicate that the system performance in mean queue size(MQS), mean latency time (MLT) and thruput are improved when comparing with the classical polling model.

articleTitle: The research and rectification on the test of immunity to electromagnetic RF fields for electrical energy meter
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the wide application of electronic equipment and the popularization of electrical energy meter of state Grid, the electrical energy meter of site operation is often subject to various types of interference, the EMC of electrical energy meter become increasingly prominent. This methods and the problems of radio frequency electromagnetic field radiated immunity test are analyzed and discussed, the anti-jamming capability of electrical energy meter is improved by using the EMC technology. After rectification, the electrical energy meter passed the radio frequency electromagnetic field radiated immunity test, The measurement performance of the electrical energy meter is guaranteed, the legal rights and interests of both side of power supply and power demand are not damaged.

Author Keywords: test of immunity to electromagnetic RF fields

articleTitle: Research on UPFC fault diagnosis based on wavelet transform and support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: At present, the way of dealing with UPFC faults in the power grid is accomplished by relay protection. As the protection equipment removes the entire UPFC system when the UPFC fails, the maintenance personnel cannot get the fault information. In response to the problem of long fault time and low reliability, a fault diagnosis method is proposed in this paper. After processed for twice, the UPFC DC side voltage and current signals are selected to be analyzed by using db2 wavelet. The fault points are found by the 6th layer wavelet signal and then the eigenvalues of the electrical signal waveforms are extracted. The eigenvectors consisted of eigenvalues are classified by the support vector machine (SVM) to realize the fault diagnosis of UPFC. The results of UPFC fault diagnosis provide maintenance basis for maintenance personnel, so that maintenance work is more targeted and the recovery is faster.

articleTitle: Study on dual-channel quartz crystal testing technology
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A study on π network zero phase testing method-based dual-channel quartz crystal testing technology is conducted, and a testing system designed to improve the testing efficiency of quartz crystal. The testing system is composed of computer, PCI circuit, CPLD logic control circuit, dual-port RAM, ARM, DDS signal source, π network, frequency mixing and amplitude/phase detection circuit, and amplifying circuit etc. Experiments have shown that the testing accuracy of series resonant frequency <;±2ppm, while the frequency consistency error of dual-channel testing is <;±1ppm within a testing range of 200MHz.

articleTitle: Comparator based fast demodulation method for airborne secondary surveillance radar test
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Secondary surveillance radar (SSR) is an important kind of airborne device of avionics system for various types of aircrafts, which bears the function of communication, navigation and identification during every flight mission. This paper proposes a digital demodulation method based on comparator binary quantization. The theory of demodulation, the hardware architecture and the diagram of logic design are described. The symbol error rate, the processing time and the test result are presented. Compared with traditional demodulation algorisms, the proposed method takes a distinct advantage of its processing speed and resource consumption, with which there is a great theoretical and practical value in the research, testing and daily maintenance of SSR.

articleTitle: Operation and control of pressure retarded osmosis for maximum power
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper investigates the process of pressure retarded osmosis (PRO) for conversion of salt gradient energy. It demonstrates the relationship between net power produced by the process, and the conditions under which the process is operated. Analysis and simulation are used to show the need for careful selection of operation conditions. Control strategies for achieving target conditions are presented and demonstrated. The lack of in-situ test methods for validation and calibration of the proposed systems is also discussed.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-speed server based on dynamic thread pool
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Because there are lots of wind generating sets in large wind farms, real-time monitoring and diagnosis of each point should be carried out in real time. Large amounts of real-time monitoring data need to be sent to the data server, and provides monitoring data for the visual client. it puts forward a high requirement to the real-time capability and data throughput of the data server. Dynamic thread pool can be applied to the high speed data server software system of large fan monitoring and diagnosis system. The dynamic thread pool method is used to solve the high concurrency problems in the data server. According to the experiment, the dynamic thread pool method is more efficient than traditional thread pool.

articleTitle: Study on the asymmetric bistability of the vibration energy harvester based on diamagnetic levitation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To improve the output characteristics and enlarge the working bandwidth of the vibration energy harvester based diamagnetic levitation, the asymmetric bistability of the energy harvester is studied. The analysis model of the energy harvester is established in COMSOL<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">™</sup>, and nonlinear vibration model of the energy harvester is established in MATLAB. Under different structural parameters and external excitations, the response of the floating magnet is obtained. The results show that the asymmetric bistable model has a wider response and lower energy barrier than symmetrical model. It is easier to achieve periodic motion with large amplitude, which is beneficial to improve the output voltage of the energy harvester. Simultaneously, three connection modes of the coils are compared, and it is found that the optimized coils connection pattern can significantly improve the output voltage of the energy harvester. Finally when the floating distance is 4.2mm, there are two stable equilibrium positions: Z+=0.86mm and Z-= −1.00mm respectively, and, the negative and positive displacements of the floating magnet are about −1.3mm and +1.25mm respectively. When the upper and lower coil layers both are one layer, the maximum output voltage of the energy harvester is about 3mV.

articleTitle: Development on-line gas flow calibration system based on piston prover
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper developed an on-line gas flow calibration system based on piston prover. The principle of clearance-seal was introduced briefly, and then the realization of the piston prover based on clearance-seal was discussed in detail. According to the experimental results, the repeatability and precision was superior to the soap film flow meter. Within the range of 5-500 sccm, the testing relative error is less than 1%o, which indicates the high precision of the device. In addition, with the advantages of high degree of automation and outstanding reliability, this calibration system could be widely applied to various fields of on-line and off-line gas flow calibration.

articleTitle: Power spectral density estimation from random interleaved samples
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Random interleaved sampling (RIS) is a widely used non-uniform sampling technique in signal sampling system. RIS composites a waveform with high equivalent rate from low speed samples acquired using single analog-to-digital converter (ADC). However, in many applications, we are only interested in power spectral density (PSD) of signal, and the whole waveform reconstruction is inefficient and unnecessary. In this paper, an algorithm is proposed to estimate PSD of signal, which is captured using RIS technique. Duo to incoherence between trigger pulse and sampling clock, the trigger time interval may be randomly distributed within the range of a period of sampling clock. The quantization error always exists. The fractional delay filter is incorporated into RIS to mitigate the quantization error that would degrade estimate performance. Experiment is reported to evaluate the proposed PSD estimation algorithm, and the results indicate that the proposed approach is feasible and efficient.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis-application of PCA-SVM in state identification method of marine centrifugal pump
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper proposes a state identification method of centrifugal pump based on algorithms of wavelet transform, principal component analysis (PCA), and support vector machine (SVM), and provides concrete steps of the fault diagnosis model establishment of marine centrifugal pump using the method. The analysis object is the pressure pulsation signal at the exit of the centrifugal pump, and the characteristic set is constructed by the wavelet packet algorithm. The test data of the centrifugal pump in the normal state is regarded as the sample data. After PCA, the dimension of the feature set is reduced, and the feature extraction model is established. Finally, the state identification and fault diagnosis of the marine centrifugal pump are realized by applying SVM. In the practical application, the method improves the limitation of the traditional state intelligent identification method and the difficulty of setting the threshold, and its validity has been verified in the experiment.

articleTitle: Underdetermined mixing matrix estimation algorithm based on data field clustering and cloud model partitioning
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper analyses the estimation problem of the underdetermined mixing matrix for the blind signal separation. A novel algorithm involving data field clustering (DFC) and cloud model partitioning (CMP) is proposed. Firstly, single source points (SSPs) are identified by argument detection method. Then, the DFC algorithm is innovatively introduced to select the high potential SSPs to determine initial cluster centers. Finally, the membership degree of the adjacent clustering centers is obtained by combining the cloud model method to correct the clustering centers, and the estimation of the mixing matrix is obtained. Experiment results indicate that the estimation problem of the adjacent cluster centers can be effectively solved by using the proposed algorithm, and the estimated mixing matrix has higher precision.

articleTitle: Design of low-voltage switch phase-sensitive protector based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To distinguish the short circuit fault overcurrent and the asynchronous motor starting overcurrent in power supply system protection, this paper described a phase-sensitive detection protector based on signal-input-capture function of the timer in STM32 chip. Through many theories, experiments and analyses, the range of the power factor used for discriminant of asynchronous motor starting was set to 0.4-0.5 in protector. The protector used the power factor as a discrimination criterion. The voltage and current sinusoidal signals were transformed to recognizable signals by the hardware, which were input to the timer and then the relevant data were gotten. At last, the data were dealt by the system task in software, gotten was the power factor of system voltage and current, which was afterwards compared with the set value to distinguish the two kinds of overcurrent. By testing, the protector measured the power factors of system accurately, which met the protection requirements.

articleTitle: Design of precision timing circuit for X-ray speed measuring instrument
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the X-ray velocity measurement instrument based on the zone-block device, it has the characteristics of short timing and high measure precision. using the fully synchronous (ie, multi-cycle synchronous) technology by single chip microcomputer overcomes the quantization error, and produce a standard time interval to the measured time interval is modified, greatly reducing the system error. The single chip microcomputer as slave computer for timing data acquisition, through the wireless data transmission module real-time transmission to the host computer processing data, realize the multi-channel time interval measurement. The experimental results show that the timing circuit has strong anti-interference ability and good linearity, which can be widely used for timing measurement system of different time synchronization system.

articleTitle: Application of state evaluation of Electric Energy Metering Device
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Electric Energy Metering Device (EEMD) is the trade settlement hub of electric energy among power generation companies, grid companies, sales companies and power users. Its operation accuracy and stability directly affect the economic interests of both sides of trade. In order to effectively track the running state of EEMD, discover problems existing in the operation period in time, and eventually minimize trading loss on both sides, the state evaluation of EEMD is required. Based on the state indexes, evaluation methods, state grades classification and result processing, this article reviews recent research on the state evaluation of EEMD and presents suggestions for improvement, aiming at making it more practical in engineering application.
