articleTitle: Photoelectric diagnoses of volume DBD by using power density modulation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Dielectric barrier discharge (DBD) reactors excited by high voltage source working with power density modulation (PDM) have widely used in their industrial applications. For the high efficiency discharge, it is necessary to investigate the variation law of the photoelectric characteristics. In this paper, a volume diffuse DBD is established by means of parallel-plate electrodes. The methods of both the electrical parameter and optical emission spectroscopy (OES) are used to diagnose the electrical and optical parameters of the self-designed DBD cell under various discharge conditions. Meanwhile, the energy efficiency ratios (EERs) of quantum yield of active species in DBD is examined by OES. We deduce a series of formulas to calculate the consumed energy of the reactor by Lissajous figures. Using these formulas, the energy of an applied cycle and the energy consumed in a certain period of time can be obtained. The EERs of quantum yield and the conversion efficiency are not a liner trend with the change of applied voltage and energy. Only increasing the applied energy or voltage will not improve quantum efficiency, when discharge reaches a condition, the production of the active species will reached best value. The diagnostic methods used in the experiment can effectively measure the photoelectric properties of DBD.

articleTitle: Acquisition and application of running state information on automatic weather station
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to realize the remote monitoring of automatic weather station timely running status, based on the function structure of the second generation automatic weather station, this paper puts forward automatic weather station internal detection point classification, status definition, encode design and file structure rules. On the basis of this work, all status information can be compiled into a file to upload to data center according to the rules, which can be facilitate to carry out AWS fault diagnosis and analysis. Application results show that the status information design and acquisition is successful. and they are very useful for real-time monitoring equipment operation, help technician to carry out maintenance and improve the efficiency of maintenance. They can also be used to evaluate the automatic weather station performance, to provide reference for technical improvement and selection of next generation AWS.

articleTitle: The design of baseband signal generator
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Baseband signal generator (BSG) is widely used in many applications. This paper analyzes the features of baseband signal. The baseband signal can be divided into two categories. A structure is proposed to generate these two types of baseband signals. The key problems such as symbol mapping, shaping filtering, data interpolation are discussed in detail. A baseband signal generator with 80MHz bandwidth and 1ksym/s-80Msym/s symbol rate is designed based on the structure proposed, which can provide many baseband signals, such as ASK, PSK, DPSK, FSK, MSK, QAM, etc. At last, the performance of baseband signal generator is given to show the effectiveness of the design.

articleTitle: Novel GNSS receiver test bench based on scenario database and signal playback technology
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: GNSS receiver testing technology plays a significant role in navigation algorithm research, receiver development and product selection. However, the distorted reflection of real environment and the non-repeatability respectively makes the mainstream satellite signal simulator and road drive test insatiable to receiver testing in specific application. In this paper, we propose a novel GNSS receiver test bench which based on real satellite signal record and playback technology. The scenario database is constructed to preserve recorded signal from real scenarios and provide rich cases for the test bench. The playback device is developed to enable high-fidelity signal playback and the front-end is developed to implement automatic testing. Experimental results show that the designed test bench is reasonable and effective to test receivers' performance in different scenarios, as well as identify their strengths and drawbacks.

articleTitle: Welcome speech by chairman of ICEMI'2017
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Presents the introductory welcome message from the conference proceedings. May include the conference officers' congratulations to all involved with the conference event and publication of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: Research on the parallel FFT based on digital down conversion and phase difference correction techniques
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As for the conflict between the sweep time and frequency resolution as well as some drawbacks, such as low precision of amplitude, existing in the spectrum analyzer based on the regular FFT technological structure, this paper introduces a technique of parallel FFT based on Digital Down Conversion or DDC and Phase Difference Correction. By operating Digital Down Converter on Intermediate Frequency (IF) sampling sequence, while substantially reducing sweep time, the indicators of frequency resolution and precision of amplitude will gain improvement. Further, this paper verifies the Real-time and feasibility in the form of FPGA logic design.

articleTitle: Kalman timescale algorithm based on hydrogen clock ensemble
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The selection of timescale algorithm will have a great influence on the accuracy and stability of timescale. To improve the accuracy and stability of timescale, this paper studied the stochastic model of the hydrogen clock and Hadamard deviation for researching the Kalman timescale algorithm based on the hydrogen clock ensemble, which is quite different from the traditional Kalman timescale algorithm based on the model of cesium-beam clock ensemble, mixed ensemble and Allen deviation. The Hadamard variance is used to describe the stability of clock frequency in this paper; it will improve the precision of the Hydrogen Clock Ensemble. By using Hadamard variance instead of Allen avariance, it can overcome the influence of frequency drift. In this paper, the clock whose stability is best is chosen as the reference clock so that the accuracy and stability of the hydrogen clock ensemble will be improved. The experiment data of the hydrogen clock ensemble in the timekeeping laboratory of National Institute of Metrology (NIM) in China were processed; the frequency stability can be improved to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-15</sup>. The results verified that the Kalman timescale algorithm based on the hydrogen clock ensemble is effective.

articleTitle: The adaptive hybrid algorithm for sea clutter denoising based on CEEMDAN
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Based on the complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (CEEMDAN) theory, a new adaptive hybrid algorithm for sea clutter denoising is proposed. The chaotic sea clutter signals are decomposed into several intrinsic modal functions (IMF) which start from high-frequency scales to low-frequency scales by using CEEMDAN. According to the relationship between the pretreatment threshold layer and the maximum cross correlation coefficient of the original signal and each IMF corresponding the layer, the proposed algorithm can independently select the wavelet threshold denoising to pretreat. After the pretreatment of original signals, we continue to decompose the signal by CEEMDAN. And later, according to the relationship between the first local minimum corresponding the layers of two adjacent critical IMFs identified by the cross correlation coefficients of the original signal and each IMF, the proposed algorithm adaptively selects the IMFs which need to be filtered. Finally, the IMFs after filtering are reconstructed into a new signal. Rossler, Lorenz system and the measured sea clutter data were selected as examples to study, the result shows that: under the condition of low noise (SNR ≥ 5dB) and high noise (SNR ≤ 0dB), the proposed algorithm can decrease the root mean square error by at least 57% and 72% compared with wavelet threshold denoising etc, the signal to noise ration increased by 3.18-5.64db and 5.73-7.45db. Moreover, the root mean square error after sea clutter signal denoising can be reduced by one order of magnitude, reaching 0.0006147 while the model before denoising only reach 0.0084, which shows that the proposed algorithm is effective for sea clutter signal denoising.

articleTitle: RFID data fusion algorithm based on spatio-temporal semantics in internet of things
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Information sensing and processing of Internet of things (IoT) is the most basic function, which is of special significance to the spatio-temporal characteristics. Used spatio-temporal correlation of RFID data, based on the perception data semantic representation, an IoT RFID data fusion processing algorithm based on spatio-temporal semantics has been proposed. Firstly, the data of the same time, different space position is used for spatial fusion processing, then the data of the same equipment, different time is used for time fusion processing in the order of time. The experiment results indicate that our algorithm can effectively remove redundancy data, reduce the amount of data and relieve the waste of system resource. And the proposed method has a certain feasibility and validity.

articleTitle: Analysis of ionospheric delay correction methods for BeiDou navigation satellite system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Satellite navigation signal is affected by ionospheric delay during transmission and it is modified by different models. The residual errors are different and it leads to the influence on timing and positioning accuracy of satellite navigation system. In this paper, Klobuchar model, grid model and dual-frequency correction method are introduced respectively. The timing errors of BeiDou satellites are calculated by using these three methods. And then according to their timing errors, correction accuracy of these ionospheric delay correction methods are analyzed and compared. It is shown that the correction accuracy of dual-frequency correction method is highest which is followed by grid model and Klobuchar model for BeiDou users. The correction accuracy of grid model is higher which is followed by Klobuchar model.

articleTitle: A recognition algorithm for BPSK/QPSK signals based on generalized Pareto distribution
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm for recognizing BPSK/QPSK signal is proposed. Extreme value theory is introduced, and an exceedance sequence is built from the modified spectrum obtained by the squaring operation of the observed signal, and the problem of recognizing the BPSK/QPSK signal is transformed to the problem of whether the distribution of the exceedance sequence approximately follows its standard generalized Pareto distribution or not. Finally, the Kolmogorov — Smirnov test is applied to perform the goodness-of-fit test of the generalized Pareto distribution of the exceedance sequence to complete the task of BPSK/QPSK signal recognition. Computer simulation results show that the recognition performance is good when the signal-to-noise ratio is moderate and does not require prior information such as noise variance.

articleTitle: Modeling hysteresis of Giant Magneto Resistive and Tunnel Magneto Resistance sensors at high frequency based on automatic test system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the widely application of Giant Magneto Resistive(GMR) and Tunnel Magneto Resistance(TMR) sensors in the field of current detection and high frequency magnetic field measurement, the output characteristic of the sensors has been studied detailed recent years. As known, hysteresis is the major reason that causes measurement error and most recent researches are focusing on static hysteresis characteristics. However, the sensor maximum hysteresis error is not a constant when the frequency of input magnetic field changes. In fact, the maximum hysteresis error may increase with the frequency increasing. Therefore, in this paper, we present the relationship between them and design the automatic hysteresis test system, then fit the model with the acquisition data. The research presented in this paper is the foundational work to study the sensors hysteresis compensation deeply.

articleTitle: A state monitoring method of fire water supply system based on hydraulic pressure mean value
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Real-time control of urban fire water supply system status, to ensure the safety and reliability of fire fighting and rescue is of great significance. This paper proposes a method of monitoring the status of urban firefighting water supply system based on water pressure mean. It theoretically analyzed the principle and realization method of sliding filter for hydraulic pressure sensor, and emphatically studied the time domain law of hydraulic pressure signal. The differences in the water pressure mean values in different states of water system were studied in detail. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm was verified by the actual leakage test. The results show that the method can obtain the status of the fire water supply system accurately, and monitor the abnormal state of the system in real time, which provide a reliable information guarantee for the fire rescue operation command.

articleTitle: Effective critical gate identification for mitigating circuit aging using gate replacement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: NBTI effect has become a major problem for device reliability in Nano CMOS technology. The aging issue of logic gate caused by NBTI can be alleviated by gate replacement techniques. This paper proposes an efficient metric to identifying the critical gates and an improved gate replacement algorithm. Firstly, an aging analysis framework considering the internal nodes information of the circuit is developed. The metric introduces a need consider view of the critical gate's output changes may affect subsequent logical gate to identify critical gates. Finally, the improved gate replacement algorithm is applied to replace the critical gates in circuit. Experimental results based on 45nm transistor process model and ISCAS85 benchmark circuit show that, compared with the existing gate replacement techniques, the proposed methods can identify the critical gates more accurately with the average delay improvement rate of 25.11% with less overhead.

articleTitle: Blind identification of spatial multiplexing and alamouti space-time block code signals based on order statistics
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The identification algorithm for a multiple-input and multiple-output system employing the Spatial Multiplexing (SM) and Alamouti (AL) space-time block codes (STBC) is investigated under the assumption of unknown parameters of the coding scheme, the received signal and noise variance. The order statistic of the cross-correlation spectrum between different received antennas is utilized as a feature to discriminate the coding type, and the tests threshold is selected based on the constant false alarm rate criterion. We proposed two methods to compute the threshold, one is based on the exact cumulative distribution function (CDF) of the maximum of the cross-correlation spectrum, and the other relies on the extreme value distribution. Simulations show that the proposed algorithms are effective and the performances of them are both superior to the convention cyclostationarity-based algorithm.

articleTitle: DOA estimation of partially polarized signals using conjugate MUSIC
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the developments in radar signal processing, it is more common that the received signals are the combinations of noncircular and circular ones. Some variations of MUSIC and ESPRIT have been developed to cope with the case. One typical method has been discussed in [F. Gao, A. Nallanathan, Y. Wang, “Improved MUSIC Under the Coexistence of Both Circular and Noncircular Sources”, IEEE TRANSACTIONS ON SIGNAL PROCESSING, vol.56, no. 7, pp.3033-3038], where all the sources are completely polarized (CP). In this correspondence, an algorithm named conjugate MUSIC is proposed to estimate the Direction-of-arrival (DOA) of partially polarized (PP) signals. Compared with the conventional MUSIC, the conjugated version improves the estimation accuracy by exploiting the noncircularity. Numerical examples show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Classification and recognition of voltage sags based on KFCM — SVM
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Voltage sag is a serious power quality problem which has a profound effect on the electrical equipment and the users. Reliable data platform has been provided for real-time monitoring and scientific management of voltage sags by construction and development of on-line monitoring system. The valuable information extraction from massive data is an important problem that needs to be solved urgently. Sags classification and recognition by data mining are the effective means. The KFCM - SVM method proposed in this paper has the advantages as following: Firstly, reasonable classification and optimization of historical data can be realized by KFCM. Secondly, effective recognition of the voltage sag events is executed by SVM. Thirdly, the typical features are selected with high separability. The model, which is more suitable for online systems, is simple with small calculation. The effectiveness of this proposed method is verified by historical data modeling.

articleTitle: Research of the on-line system for detecting metal particles in oil
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Wear is one important type of the common mechanical faults. The number and size information of wear metal particles in lubricating oil can reflect the wear fault state of mechanical equipment. Electromagnetic particle information detection is one important method of particle detection. It has the advantages of simple structure, fast response, small influence of external interference such as vibration and oil bubbles, and so on. In this paper, aiming at the difficulties of particle electromagnetic detection, the mathematical model of exciting magnetic field and induction electromotive force was analyzed. The structure of differential screw electromagnetic sensor was designed. The direct digital frequency synthesis method was used to generate the excitation signal. Based on STM32F103 and MK60DN512 DSP chips, the signal detection hardware system was designed. The information analysis software system was designed based on QT C++ language. The developed system can detect the minimum number of 180 mesh wear metal particles, and it can be the research condition for the analysis of mechanical equipment wear state, fault diagnosis and early fault warning.

articleTitle: A relay-triggered cooperative spectrum sensing in cognitive radio networks
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A relay-triggered cooperative spectrum sensing scheme is proposed in this paper to detect the spectrum opportunities for cognitive radio (CR) networks. Firstly, we design a relay-triggered individual spectrum sensing scheme. Specifically, we exploit a relay signal generated by a cognitive transmitter (CT) who has relaying capability and acts as a full-duplex amplitude-and-forward relay to trigger the primary link's close-loop power control (CLPC) which has been frequently used in practical wireless communication application, resulting in primary transmitter adjusts its transmit power under CLPC, the CR receiver observes the energy of the primary signal and decides whether the primary receivers (PRs) are within or out of CT's coverage. Then, considering the fact that local spectrum sensing may be not reliable due to the fading and shadowing effects, we further develop the proposed individual spectrum sensing scheme to a new collaborative one where multiple CRs are involved in sensing and the common receiver combines the decisions received from cooperative CRs to get a final decision which will improve the sensing performance. Finally, the performances of the proposed schemes are illustrated by simulations.

articleTitle: Review of Distributed Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Distributed video coding is a new video coding mode, and it can shift the computational complexity from encoder to decoder. That makes it very suitable for wireless video terminals with limited computing capabilities, memory and power. This technology is rapidly developing with emerging video applications such as wireless video surveillance, wireless digital camera and mobile video telephony. This paper summarizes the distributed video coding technology from the theory to the application from the perspective of basic principle, coding framework, key technology and development trend. On the basis of these, this paper proposes several aspects of distributed video coding that is worthy of further study.

articleTitle: Design of data editor for deep storage data generator
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Data generator (DG) plays a very important role in digital testing, which has the characteristics of large data capacity, strong and high-efficiency programmable ability. This paper presents a new data editor of the DG based on hierarchical design, which divides the data editor into data unit editing and sequence editing. To program the deep storage pattern data high-efficiency and convenience, the data unit editing is realized by classification methods: patterns data customization, incremental editing, patterns data import. The Patterns customizers are designed to generate rich popular patterns. The function of incremental editing is to edit user-defined data. And import external pattern data is permitted. Sequence editing is designed to arrange data units and enhance the programmable length of the data editor. The function of the designed data editor is verified in engineering.

articleTitle: Distributed test system based on publish/subscribe middleware
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to improve the testing ability of traditional dedicated test system, this paper proposes and designs a distributed test system with the cross-platform, generalization, and publish / subscribe middleware. The distributed test system is developed by B/S architecture, which consists of the system website deployed on the test master server and a number of test service nodes that perform data interaction through Data Distribution Services (DDS) middleware. The test resources on each test service node can be fully used by the test system to maximize the utilization rate of test resources. This test system completes the testing tasks and improves the testing efficiency in the test application of Distributed Integrated Modular Avionics (DIMA) system.

articleTitle: Active calibration technology for polarimetrie radar measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Polarimetrie measurement is a prerequisite for applications such as radar target recognition and anti-interference based on polarimetry information. The precision of polarimetric measurement depends on the accuracy of the calibration of polarimetric radar systems. In this paper, a new polarimetric calibration method by designing a high-Precision polarimetric active radar calibrator(PARC) is proposed, which can accurately calibrate the radar transmitting and receiving channels, respectively. System composition and key technologies of the PARC are explained. And then the whole calibration method is provided.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of TEPC based on GEANT4
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The evaluation of human radiation dose and the biological effect caused by radiation are one of the important tasks of nuclear medicine and radiation protection. Tissue Equivalent Proportional Counter can be used to measure the distribution of energy deposition in micro-space, and it is an important experimental method to study the interaction process of micron-scale charged particles and matter. By using the micro-dose spectroscopy, we can study the relationship between radiative deposition energy distribution and radiation biological effect, thus establish the radiation biological effect of different particles, and provide technical parameters for macroscopic dosimetry. Based on Geant4 software, a physical process simulation ability of Tissue Equivalent Proportional Counter(TEPC) is established to realize the physical modeling of the detector structure; The gamma ray and neutron nuclear reaction database, particle interface function, physical process tracking interface function, output interface function of the software is used to simulating the particles in the detector energy deposition process. Simulation experimental results show that theoretical calculation model based on GEANT4 for the Micro-dosimetry simulation study of TEPC is reliable. This is basically consistent with the principle of DNA scaling, the direction of development is to realize the simulation of DNA scale action process, to provide experimental verification method for the theoretical modeling of the interaction between Ray and matter in DNA scale, and to provide an experimental means for understanding the radiation hazard of the human body in depth.

articleTitle: Transit time measurement for ultrasonic tomographic velocimeters
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The transit time measurement for ultrasonic tomographic velocimeters is bothered by poor signal noise ratio (SNR) and multipath interferences. Hence, a neighborhood assessment correlation method was proposed in this paper. First, an improved Hilbert transform correlation algorithm was employed for preliminary transit time measurement, and the reliabilities of the measurement results were evaluated by the normalized correlation coefficients. Then, the unreliable measurement results were further revised by a neighborhood assessment process. As demonstrated by the experiments, this method could eliminate all cycle-slipping errors in the flow velocity range of 0 m/s-3.83 m/s, and the transit time measurement precision was up to 52.2 ns. The flow velocity fields reconstructed from the transit time fit well with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Error prediction method of electronic transformers based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the gradual application of electronic transformers in the intelligent substation, the influence of the typical disturbing source on the electronic transformers is gradually to the industry's attention. In order to ensure the accuracy and reliability of electronic transformers, it is necessary to determine the error of the electronic transformers accurately through the study of the influence factors of the measurement error of the electronic transformers. In this regard, this paper proposes a transformer error prediction method which combines RBF neural network prediction with K-Means clustering algorithm. First, the historical data are classified by K-Means clustering. Then, train the prediction model with the historical data clustered. Take the influencing factors such as temperature, load capacity and magnetic field as the independent variables and the error as the prediction target to establish the prediction model. The prediction model is suitable for the analysis of a large number of data and can accurately predict the error. After using this model to analyze the long-term experimental data of Dongshan substation in 2016, the relative error of the error result is around 5%, which is relatively and verifies the validity of the model.

articleTitle: A novel design of fully connected communication network for Bio-inspired hardware
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper presents a novel design of fully connected communication network for Bio-inspired Electronic Array. The network mainly comprises neighbor connection, bus connection and NoC network. Neighbor connection and NoC network are used to transfer computing results of adjacent and nonadjacent electronic cells, respectively. Bus connection is responsible for self-repairing. In order to avoid conflict, Round-Robin algorithm and a polling arbiter is used to arbitrate. Meanwhile, we design a 4×4 multiplier based on this architecture. The experimental verify the fully connected communication ability.

articleTitle: Study on on-line detection scheme of DC electric energy metering for electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the periodic verification difficult problems of electric vehicle energy meter, put forward a kind of real — time on — line detection scheme of energy metering accuracy un6497der working conditions of electric vehicles, and developed successfully portable on-line detection device of DC energy meter for vehicles. Achieved high-precision current sampling by using zero-flux current sensing technology, reduced the device detection error jump through the average pulse method to improve the detection accuracy of the device. Selected electric vehicle operating conditions to road test, the actual program measurement accuracy can reach 0.2s level, can be applied to on-line detection of vehicle DC measuring instruments below level 1, with a certain value to promote.

articleTitle: FPGA based echo delay control method for pulse radar testing
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A compact and low-cost echo delay control method for pulse radar testing is proposed. Unlike the traditional delay technology based on surface acoustic wave (SAW) filter and fiber delay line, this paper provides a field programmable gate array (FPGA) based delay control method to fulfil the tasks of radar pulse acquisition, storage and delayed forwarding. Programmable resources of phase lock loops (PLL) and memories within the FPGA are used. Experiment results show that the proposed approach can be used for making a controllable pulse echo delay platform with the minimum delay step is less than 1ns, and the maximum delay time is greater than 200us.

articleTitle: The development of aero-engine tip-clearance measurement technology: A simple review
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Due to the uncoordinated deformation of aero-engine casing and rotor, it is imperative to measure the tip-clearance and control it dynamically. In this paper, the current research status of tip-clearance at home and abroad were introduced, including the common tip-clearance measurement methods, their measuring principles, application conditions, advantages and disadvantages. In mentioned measurement methods, the one based on optical measurement technology has the advantages in high precision, strong adaptability, corrosion resistance, high temperature resistant, and immunity to the electromagnetic interference. Meanwhile non-contact measurement can be realized by it. The optical measurement has become the research focus in the field of tip-clearance measurement technology, and should be vigorously developed.

articleTitle: Outage analysis of cognitive energy harvesting relaying networks with opportunistic relay selection over nakagami-m fading channel
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper studies the outage probability (OP) of cognitive decode-and-forward (DF) relaying networks with energy harvesting in the Nakagami-m fading channel. To ensure the reliability of the transmission, the cognitive transmitter (S) communicates with cognitive receiver (D) via the relay, which is selected from multiple relays based on an opportunistic relay selection strategy. The transmit power of S and relays are constrained by the maximum tolerable interference power on the multiple primary users (PUs). Two protocols of energy harvesting at relay, i.e., power splitting (PS) and time switching (TS) protocols are studied. We derive the OP of the cognitive DF relaying networks in PS and TS protocols, respectively and study the impact of the data rate, time switching rate, the fading coefficients, the number of PUs and relays on the cognitive networks. The Monte-Carlo simulations are provided to verify the correctness of our analysis results.

articleTitle: The implementation scheme and key technologies of the space-borne terahertz high-speed transmission system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the great demand for space communications in our country and higher requirements in the new situation of space communication technology. In this paper, we present the implementation scheme and key technologies of the space-borne terahertz transmission system: Based on SiGe BiCMOS technology, a reconfigurable receiver of low noise and high sensitivity based on super heterodyne reception is proposed. The realization of high speed modulation and transmission of high data rate is pointed out. It is possible to achieve a single chip with a multi-frequency band of terahertz communication and the whole scheme also supports multiple waveform coding and complex modulation. This provides a feasible plan for the development of the space industry in China.

articleTitle: Research on barometric altimeter aiding GPS arithmetic in challenge environment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the challenge environments such as urban canyon or high mountains, the positioning accuracy is often challenged when the number of GPS visible satellites is less than four or their constellation configuration is inadequate. Aids of other systems is necessary to improve the availability and integrity of the GPS in challenged environments. Therefore, barometric altimeter aiding GPS integration in land application is designed. An altitude assistant GPS positioning algorithm and its iteration formula is presented. Then, the contrast test is carried out. A high accuracy altitude is achieved by using a barometric altimeter, which compensates GPS position accuracy in the vertical direction. The vertical accuracy of the vehicle is well known in the cloverleaf junction using the integration system. The results show that the availability of the aided system is improved by more than 50% in challenge environment, and improved the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Building vibration measurement with double magnetic suspension vibrators based on wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to measure the vibration of the building generated by large infrastructure equipments, magnetic levitation technique was used. A vibration measurement model with double magnetic suspension vibrators was designed. The function of magnetic repulsion and displacement of the vibrator was obtained by means of the measured and least squares function fitting method. The vibration equations of the two magnetic suspension vibrators were deduced respectively. A simulation model of vibration measurement system with double magnetic suspension vibrators was established. The simulation shows that the sensitivity of the double magnetic suspension vibrators is higher than that of the single magnetic suspension vibrator. When these large infrastructure equipment work, the vibrations of the building were measured. The data components of the vibration signals were analyzed by wavelet decomposition method. Finally, the free vibration waveform of the buildings, the vibration waveform of the building generated by excavators and forklifts were reconstructed. The experimental results show that the magnetic levitation measurement method is suitable for low frequency vibration measurement and its measurement sensitivity is higher. The method can be used to assess the level of vibration generated by large infrastructure equipments.

articleTitle: The merging design method of instrument software based on the SCPI command set
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The local control and the remote control are the two basic ways of test instrument. Usually the local control program and the remote control program are developed respectively according to a specific operating system. The workload of the software is large and the transportability is poor. In order to greatly reduce the software workload and improve the operating efficiency of the code, this paper presents the idea of merging the local control program and the remote control program. Addition, the cross-system design method is employed to improve software transportability. The design core of the software architecture is generation, transmission and analysis of SCPI commands. To unify control mode, all of users' operations are abstracted as SPCI commands, sent and translated to control the instrument, the way that avoids transmitting large capacity data. Therefore, the remote control program can be achieved only by transplanting of a few modules of the local control program.

articleTitle: A small buoy for flux measurement in air-sea boundary layer
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As the promising flux measure area is within the air-sea boundary layer, a flux buoy is a better choice. Generally, large vessels have to be used in these flux monitoring tasks with buoys. This paper describes a small buoy which is supported by national ocean technology center for flux measurement in air-sea boundary layer, capable of rapidly deployment and accurately measuring atmospheric and sea surface variables. It can be easily dissembled, carried, deployed and acquire meteorological and hydrological data, such as pressure, temperature and wind speed. The algorithm, which is based on the Monin-Obukhov similarity theory, the structure, which has an anti-rotation character, sensors installed on the buoy which have high accuracy and good stability and the process of the buoy control system are introduced in details. The buoy has been deployed in a sea area as a field test, and has a promising result. Compared to the traditional flux buoy, the small flux buoy is not only small and light in weight, and also can be used for flexible, low-cost and effective flux measurement. Besides, its low cost makes measurement in wide range possible. The buoy provides a new solution for air-sea flux monitoring and data source for flux model algorithm research.

articleTitle: Multi-Vth technique based on potential critical paths for NBTI effect and leakage tradeoff
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: NBTI-induced PMOS transistor aging has become an important influence factor of the circuit reliability in the current technological dimension. In this paper, Multi-Vth technique based on potential critical paths for NBTI effect and leakage tradeoff is proposed. The potential critical paths can be found at the preset timing margin and the critical gates in the potential critical paths can be replaced with the low threshold voltage type through the optimization algorithm mentioned in our paper. The experimental results on ISCAS85 benchmark circuits at 45nm node show that the after-aging delay improvement rate is up to 12.95%, which is obviously better than the current multi-threshold voltage scheme. Simultaneously, the leakage power overhead is less. Our method is more effective for the larger circuit in the anti-aging aspect.

articleTitle: Coding-based cooperative caching scheduling method
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, widely usage of mobile devices and explosive growth of mobile data, data dissemination strategy becomes a key factor in the emerging mobile application development. Based on C/S and P2P hybrid cooperative data dissemination architecture framework for server side and client side, we propose a scheduling algorithm and the related cooperative caching strategy. The scheduling process aimed at Maximum Response was proved as Maximum Independent Set problem. Adopting tentative schedule, we filter the data with higher broadcast efficiency by applying GMIN model combined with network coding which can increase capacity in one broadcast. Finally, the CMRCA protocols are carried out to validate their efficiency and capability. Through the simulation experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed scheme is proved.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of 250MSPS wireless smart virtual oscilloscope
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a novel high-efficient and full-function virtual oscilloscope is proposed and developed. The method exploits fully the advantages of smart terminal and wireless communication to extend the application of traditional digital oscilloscope. An Android based smart terminal device is used as the center of data processing in the oscilloscope. Meanwhile, Wi-Fi based wireless network is applied to achieve high-speed data transmission and fast system controlling between signal acquisition front-end and smart terminal. Combined with the advantage of multithread technique in smart terminal system, a solution of fluency data processing and system controlling is designed. In addition, in order to match different screen resolutions, an adaptive pixel matching method is proposed for optimal waveform and interface display effect. Finally, we achieved a dual-channel 200MSPS smart virtual oscilloscope featuring a full-function, small-size, low-power and good user's experience. It also makes the traditional oscilloscope more intelligent and expands the application field of traditional digital oscilloscope.

articleTitle: A method of testability analysis and design based on FMEA extension
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) is widely accepted and used in many engineering fields as a common method of failure analysis. Also, FMEA is expected to extend its capabilities from traditional applications. This paper focuses on functional extension of FMEA in testability. Traditional FMEA is a qualitative analytical method, while testability needs quantitative analysis, which makes it difficult to apply traditional FMEA method directly on testability analysis and design. Accordingly, this paper proposes a method of testability analysis and design based on functional extension of FMEA. Firstly, characteristics of traditional FMEA method and testability analytical method are compared in this paper to find out the difference and the connection, and then the feasibility of FMEA extension in testability is put forward. Secondly, the corresponding extension method is put forward combining with the parameters of structural and functional state, and inference algorithm of insuring test set is also presented. At last, the validity of this method is verified by an example. The method proposed in this paper effectively extends the application field of FMEA method, and has a good application value in engineering practice.

articleTitle: InGaAs/InP single-photon avalanche diodes performance variation with charge layer width and doping
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this letter, we have investigated the performance dependence of a planar-type Geiger-mode single-photon avalanche photodiodes (SPADs) on the multiplication and charge layer widths and doping. SPADs have great importance in the near infrared (NIR) wavelength range between 1.0 and 1.7 μm especially telecommunication wavelength. The planar SPAD was fabricated by standard chemical vapor deposition (CVD). Our results shows the width of the multiplication layer is critical parameter and tradeoff should be considered to modulate the dark current rate and photodetection efficiency. The fabricated SPAD with the multiplication width of 1.3 μm shows low enough dark current and high photocurrent. To prevent early breakdown at the periphery of the diode, guard rings and floating guard-rings were considered. The performance of the fabricated SPADs has been measured by a thermoelectric cooling system.

articleTitle: Design of the laser gun bullets based on microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Police lab for testing requirements bullet speed, we designed a microcontroller based on the laser gun. The microcontroller as the core for speedometer, with laser detection plate module, thermal Printer module, display and buttons module, USB data interface module, wireless modules and stable voltage module, it can measure the speed of a series of work by Ligation of these modules. First, fired projectiles for testing by the laser detection plate module. Then, Transfer the detected data into the microcontroller. In the microcontroller detection data is processed and then printed out by thermal printer. Via USB data interface for data uploaded to a computer to save. While on the steps required to be operated by the controller.

articleTitle: A novel dual-band dipole antenna based on triangular shaped fractal parasitic elements
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel dual-band dipole antenna based on triangular shaped fractal parasitic elements (TSFPE) is proposed. The dual-band characteristic of the structure is achieved by joining TSFPE to the two arms of the dipole antenna symmetrically. The lower band is realized by arms of the dipole antenna and the higher band is realized by TSFPE. Both of the simulated results and measured results show that the proposed structure has great performances. Our research would enrich the types of dual-band dipole antenna and provide a reference for further researches of TSFPE in multi-band antenna.

articleTitle: Design and realization of integrated patrol-robot system for underground pipe gallery
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Underground pipe gallery is a mixture of municipal utilities pipelines, such as power, communication, gas, water supply and drainage, heat, etc. it is the core of a city's normal operation. Therefore, it is vital to monitor the operation of the underground pipe gallery. In view of the current lack of underground pipe gallery manual monitoring and the limitation of multiply camera monitoring, this paper based on Raspberry Pi 3B as the hardware development platform, combined with infrared thermal imager, Infrared camera camera and the temperature and humidity of toxic and harmful gases, flammable and explosive gas and other gas sensors, take use of remote video surveillance, robot and image processing technology to design a real-time monitoring system for underground pipe gallery. The system can not only collect the operating environment parameters of the underground pipe gallery, but also carry out the Infrared camera image and infrared image acquisition for the running environment. The back-end of the system analyzes the collected parameters and gives alerts in an emergency. Compared with the traditional monitoring method, this system greatly improves the efficiency of monitoring, reduces the cost of inspection, and enhances the security of inspection. The experiment shows this monitoring system has good practicability.

articleTitle: Improvement of RFID locating algorithm in warehouse security system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The system uses RFID radio frequency identification technology and indoor locating technology to realize the real-time locating monitoring of warehouse goods. This paper puts forward a warehouse security system scheme based on RFID locating technology. In view of the shortcomings of the current indoor locating algorithm, the VIRE algorithm is further optimized from two aspects of “adjacent map optimization” and “error correcting method”. Through the Matlab simulation, the improved VIRE locating algorithm is simulated and compared. The simulation results show that the algorithm is optimized, and the accuracy of VIRE indoor locating is improved effectively. The system can improve the working mode of warehouse security management, effectively reduce the workload of warehouse managers and improve the efficiency of warehouse management. In addition, it helps to make up the loopholes in the security management of warehouse goods and reduce the risk of loss of goods, thus it can be used for reference in the study of warehouse security management system.

articleTitle: Research on adaptive SIFT algorithm in image matching of pipeline inner surface visual measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: SIFT algorithm has many advantages such as high matching rate and good robustness. However, it still has same imperfect. Due to the large number of key points and large amount of computation, the processing speed is very slow. This article propose an improved SIFT matching algorithm with threshold and adaptive. In this algorithm, the threshold size is changeable. The number of feature points and the spatial domain are also controllable. The matching accuracy and speed can be improved by optimizing parameters. Then stereo image matching of inner surface of pipeline can be realized. Experimental results show that the matching rate and the matching speed are improved obviously. The algorithm can be applied to the matching of the inner surface corrosion images.

articleTitle: Study on calibration of impulse current measuring system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The calibration of the impulse current measurement system has been clearly stipulated in the standard GB/T 16927.4-2014, With the implementation of GB/T 16927.4-2014. In order to promote the standardization of the calibration system, this paper analyzes the impulse current measurement system architecture, Analysis of the impulse current measurement system scale factor calibration methods and the uncertainty calculation of time-parameter measurements. Then, each test example was executed. The uncertainty of under calibration impulse current measurement system was evaluation, For the implementation of standard provides the beneficial practice and guidance.

articleTitle: Precision 1000-V DC voltage standard produced by HVDAC
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The direct current (DC) standard voltage source is a key link in the mass source system, and the laboratory universal calibrator has an output capacity of 1000 V DC voltage. In this study, the advantages and disadvantages of the DC 1000-V range, in the current calibration source are analyzed, and a high-voltage digital-to-analog converter (HVDAC) program was implemented based upon the bit expansion and amplification on the bipolar inverted T-type digital-to-analog converter (DAC). This study describes, in detail, the realization of the single-block voltage amplifier circuit, DAC bit expansion mode, the voltage module superposition in HVDAC scheme, and provides the circuit schematic. This program can be easily used to obtain high-precision, high-voltage output. The output voltage is linear, with strong burden and easy expansion. It has been successfully applied to self-developed calibration source products, in the range of ±1000 V DC, with a voltage-maximum absolute uncertainty of 18−10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−6</sup>.

articleTitle: Diagnosis via arithmetic circuit compilation of Bayesian network and calculation on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aircrafts, especially the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) are always operating in environments filled with expectations and unforeseen occasions. In addition, hardware and software failures caused by design defects are inevitable [1]. In order to avoid catastrophic failure, we must locate the failure immediately in working condition. That means real-time diagnosis. Bayesian inference has been well established in the area of diagnosis and health management. In this paper, we come up with a method to take advantage of FPGA to implement Bayesian inference, which has the features of hardware programmable and the ability of parallel computing. Therefore, we compile the Bayesian Network into arithmetic circuit, and then evaluate the arithmetic circuit on FPGA.

articleTitle: Design of measurement and control system for shock tube based calibration installation of dynamic pressure transducer
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A Calibration installation of dynamic pressure transducer based on shock tube was designed, in which the measure and control system was the most important part because it determined the precision of calibration data and results. The measure and control system consisted of pressure control system and measurement system. The pressure control system was designed to control the initial pressure in the high pressure section and low pressure section of the shock tube. The measurement system had many functions, such as test condition inverse solution, test condition monitor, sampling trigger, effective data acquisition, parameters computation, and report generation and print module, etc. It was designed to accurately measure and calculate the parameters required for calibrating a dynamic pressure transducer. The 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order expand uncertainty of the step pressure generated by the calibration installation was analyzed to be less than 3%, which met the requirement of standard calibration regulation.

articleTitle: De-noising algorithm for digital oscilloscope based on wavelet packet
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Digital oscilloscope plays a vital role in almost every field of measurement. However, the performance of the measurement is limited by noise, such as the front-end analog conditioning circuit thermal noise, quantization noise in ADC, etc. Therefore, efficient de-noising algorithm is needed to avoid substantial SNR (Signal-to-Noise Ratio) reduction of the digital oscilloscope. In this paper, we present a digital post-processing techniques to reduce noise for digital oscilloscope based on wavelet packet theory. Compared with direct modification in analog circuit design, no change is needed on the analog part of the proposed method, which is more efficient and economical. The effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method has been validated with simulations and measurements from a digital oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of motor control unit in XBT cluster launch and measurement system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that XBT is susceptible to severe sea condition and people factor which leads to poor and inefficient measurement, the realization idea of motor control unit is proposed in the design of XBT cluster launch and measurement system. The unit consists of a power management module, main control chip, communication and motor control interface module, etc. The servo motor, stepping motor and DC motor in the system can be controlled by programming the main control chip on the unit, the above three kinds of motor movement modes are combined organically to complete multiple XBT automatic launch. The test result shows that the system can accomplish multiple XBTs reliable launch in severe sea condition, and has the characteristics of high efficiency and automation, good practicability and stability.

articleTitle: Software implementation of corn grain morphology detection based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Morphological parameters of Corn grain are indexes that always been concerned by researchers in field of crop cultivation and breeding. In this article, Microsoft Visual Studio 2008 was slected as development tools, with the open source computer vision library (OpenCV2.3.1), we combined the image processing with analysis technology, and designed the testing system for morphological of Corn grain. Firstly, we used basler industrial camera to captured image of Corn grain, and pre-processed the image, then ellipsed fitting on the image of corn grain and determined the tip position of corn grain. Finally, output the results. In this paper, Software implementation of corn grain morphology detection based on Open CV can provide some reference for other biomass granule morphology research.

Author Keywords: Open CV: Corn grain : Morphology detection

articleTitle: Novel algorithm of channel estimation for CP-OFDM systems with pilot symbols in frequency domain
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A large number of pilot symbols needed to track the changes of the channel in pilot-aided channel estimation algorithms, so that the Spectrum Efficiency (SE) is reduced and the algorithm computational load is increased. In this paper, the Parameters Model (PM) for the channel frequency response is established based on the particular structure of CP-OFDM Systems (COS). Then a novel algorithm for pilot-aided channel estimation in frequency domain is given by the approximate estimation of PM based on LS. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has much lower implementation complexity compared with some well-known algorithms and achieves a good performance on channel estimation even when COS gets the maximum SE.

articleTitle: The forecast method and system of wind turbine operating status trend
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The development of wind power industry has put forward higher requirements for the remote monitoring method and system of wind turbines. To effectively guarantee the normal work of the equipment, the processing quality and fault forecast, remote on-line detection and intelligent fault diagnosis system platform is built. Firstly, the theory and method of remote monitoring and maintenance for wind turbines are put forward: dynamic characteristics degradation development tendency weak information signal processing and pre-processing, extraction of dynamic characteristics degradation trend characteristics in long-duration and variable-load state, establishment of trend prediction model and system based on combination of measured big data trend forecast and mechanical dynamic property trend prediction. Then, a remote monitoring system for wind turbines is constructed integrating with sensor technology, dynamic measurement and control technology, signal processing technology, fault pattern recognition technology and artificial intelligence technology. Field application shows that the system can effectively monitor the running status of the fan, achieve the real time alarm and running trend prediction effectively.

articleTitle: Vehicle image mosaics technology based on improved SIFT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aimed at the problem of large vehicle outline detect in the field of intelligent traffic, this paper proposes a vehicle stitching algorithm based on improved SIFT feature matching to reduce the requirements of the camera configuration and choose camera position easily. Firstly, the improved SIFT algorithm is used to extract and match feature point quickly. So the superior characteristics of SIFT algorithm is utilized to not only deal with the image's rotation, translation and illumination changes, the stability of visual change and affine transformation, but also ensure the processing speed of algorithm by reducing the complexity of the SIFT algorithm. In this paper, mismatched points are simply and quickly removed by limiting the matching line slope, which is proved to be a good result. After obtaining the stable matching points, we calculate the transformation matrix between two images. Finally, the image pyramid fusion is performed to perfect our stitching image and this pixel level processing has a good ability to eliminate fusion mosaic slot caused by camera position deviation, different light and other causes. Experiment results show that this algorithm reduces the rate of mismatching and improves the low efficiency in traditional image mosaic. The improved SIFT algorithm has distinct advantage in increasing speed, obtaining high resolution and completing vehicle images after mosaic.

articleTitle: A high-precision memory hicorder based on SoC
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces a high-precision memory hicorder based on embedded SoC, which can accurately measure amplitude, frequency etc, and record measurement results and waveform of the signal. ADC data windowed and filtered before the FFT can be more accurately calculated the amplitude of the signal, the equal-precision frequency measurement module ca n accurately measure the signal frequency. The storage solutions based on LXI's high-performance can transfer and save many channels waveform data in real time. The memory hicorder system depended on this method works accurately, stably, and high integrity, with a wide application.

articleTitle: Research on kinematic parameter calibration of handling robot
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the low accuracy of the existing handling robot, a method of compensating the error by handling the kinematic parameters of the robot is proposed. Based on the modified D-H kinematics model and the differential idea, the error model is linearized. At the same time, in order to connect the robot distance error and the absolute positioning error, the distance error model is established, and the relationship between the robot distance error and the kinematic parameter error is established. The least square method is used to solve the geometric parameters and improve the positioning accuracy of the robot. Finally, the 6-DOF handling robot was tested by monocular vision principle. The experimental results show that the mean value of the absolute value of the distance error is reduced by 77.1% compared with the compensation.

articleTitle: Research on test scheduling of 3D NoC based the strategy of bandwidth division multiplexing and multi-clock
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To improve the testing efficiency of IP core in 3-dimensional network-on-chip (3D NoC), research on test scheduling of 3D NoC under multi-constraint is conducted. In this paper, we use the strategy of dynamic bandwidth division multiplexing to increase the utilization of 3D NoC. The strategy of multi-clock is used to determine the clock frequency of each IP core according to the ratio of power consumption and test time to shorten its test time. The improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to find the optimal solution under the dual constraints of power consumption and bandwidth, which combined with the characteristics of 3D NoC. The location and order of transmission of the IP core's test data are viewed as two variables to optimize. The optimal speed and accuracy of the algorithm are advanced by adding the Explosion Operator (EO) and Specific Introductory Formula (SIF) in early phase, and the strategy of local optimal monitoring is added in the later phase. The circuit in international standard test set ITC'02 is used as the experimental object. The experiment results show that the work in this paper can shorten the test time and improve the utilization of on-chip resources effectively.

articleTitle: Calibration accuracy analysis of satellite channel zero-value based on TtC measurement
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The calibration result of satellite channel zero-value through TtC measurement is directly related to the users' positioning and timing performance in navigation system. The paper proposes the concept of pseudo-satellite channel zero-value calibration that using a satellite signal simulator replaces the real satellite for testing, which mainly analyzes the calibration accuracy of TtC measurement. Using a delay-line instead of simulator adjustment to eliminate the system error the calibration accuracy decreases about 0.05ns on the original basis of 0.38ns. Through the testing comparison we can see the oscilloscope is better than the carrier phase receiver, with the calibration accuracy from 0.32ns up to 0.78ns.

articleTitle: Scattering from the stratified uniaxial anisotropic media in directional source excitation in the spectral domain
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to evaluat the scattering from stratified uniaxial anisotropic media (UEAM) in directional source excitation in the spectral domain. In this way, the reflection field of an infinite ideal conductor plate coated with a uniform anisotropic dielectric layer is estimated, which involves every wave mode of the multiple reflections theoretically. Initially, the spectral formulas of radiation of point source in free space and in the electric anisotropic slab under point source excitation are proposed. The boundary conditions of the upper and lower surfaces of the anisotropic plate are then used to solve the complex amplitude of the scattering field in the spectral domain. Using the saddle point method (SPT) to approximate the scattering field in the airspace, the scattering field is obtained from the scattering field. The accuracy of the approximate solution is verified by comparison with the results of the method of moments (MOM).

articleTitle: Research on high speed sampling method of nuclear pulse in the digital nuclear spectrum measurement system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The technology of nuclear spectrum measurement is an important method for the research of nuclear physics, heavy ion physics, high energy physics and nuclear technology application. In the digital nuclear spectrum measurement system, the high speed sampling method of nuclear pulse is one of the key technologies. And this method is restricted to the conversion speed of analog-to-digital chip (A/D chip) and the working frequency of digital processing chip. Article mainly research on how to implement a single high-speed A/D function by using FPGA and multi slow-speed A/D chips. And through the experiments verify the correctness and feasibility of the method, and the effect is good.

articleTitle: Fast compressive holographic 3-D image recovery for near-field synthetic aperture radar
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A fast compressive holographic 3-D image recovery approach is proposed for near-field synthetic aperture radar (SAR). Since the collected backscattered data are non-uniform spaced in K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Z</sub>, the practical holographic 3-D SAR imaging system usually uses the non-uniform fast Fourier transform (NUFFT) to K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Z</sub> reshape the data to uniformly space in K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Z</sub>. With using both the NUFFT and reversing NUFFT will lead to significant accumulate error, the proposed approach uses a truncation repair operator to construct measurement matrix Φ, and its adjoint operator Φ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">†</sup>. Based on the constructed Φ and Φ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">†</sup>, a fast compressive holographic 3-D image recovery approach is introduced step by step, which uses a fast descending regularization parameter λ method and a FISTA (Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm) updating stage to speed up the convergence. Four sets of aggregates experiments demonstrate that the proposed fast compressive approach can efficiently reconstruct holographic 3-D target images form low under-sampled measurements.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of numerical solution of high speed angular contact ball bearing mechanics model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the theory of ring raceway control and Hertz contact, the quasi-static model of angular contact ball bearing under high speed is established. In this paper, an improved Newton-Raphson algorithm is proposed to deal with initial value determination, oscillation and slow convergence problems during solving the quasi-static model of the angular contact ball bearing by the traditional Newton-Raphson algorithm. Firstly, adopting the intermediate variables and solving the nonlinear equations step by step reduces the number of unknowns and the determination of the initial values respectively. Secondly, introducing the iterative correction factor in the improved Newton-Raphson algorithm suppress oscillation in the iterative process. Genetic search strategy is used to optimize the iterative correction factor, the convergence time is further shorted. Compared with the traditional algorithm, the proposed algorithm is superior. The algorithm can effectively decrease the difficulty of solving the quasi - static model of the angular contact ball bearing and improve the convergence efficiency.

articleTitle: The research and design of single relay coded cooperative system based on Polar codes
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The Polar Codes of the famous Plotkin constructed is introduced in this paper, the paper adopted two short linear block code to construct long linear block code. The Polar codes of the destination is constructed with division cooperative manner, and by using Successive Cancellation(SC) joint decoding algorithm, the source node and the relay nodes receive the decoded information simultaneously. It can be regarded as equivalent received code words. By comparison the simulation this paper can obtain that the coded cooperative of Polar Codes is better than the performance of non-cooperative communication systems under the same conditions, and the BER performance of the coded cooperative communication system based on Polar codes is superior than of Reed-Muller codes. Thus, the result shows that coded cooperative communication of Polar codes is effective.

articleTitle: Measurement for thin film transistor electrical performance based on PXIe bus
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: As a switching element for active-matrix flat panel display, carrier mobility, current on-off ratio, threshold voltage and stability of thin film transistors (TFTs) are key indicators that determine the the performance of AM display device. On a constructed PXIe bus based TFT measurement platform, general instrument modules trigger each other interactively via PXIe backplane trigger bus, realizing high-precision automatic measurement of parameters of TFT devices. This paper introduces the design process and methods of realizing the functions of software necessary for this system so as to realize automatic testing of the output and transfer characteristics of TFT devices, and also the graphic display, data analysis and parameter calculation on the basis of measurement result. The verification result indicates that this system is structurally impact and highly precise, compatible and stable. This enables it to measure the electrical characteristics of TFTs automatically and effectively.

articleTitle: Blind calibration method for two-channel time-interleaved ADCs based on cross correlation and polynomial regression
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Time-interleaved analog-to-digital convert (TIADC) is an effective method to improve the sampling rate of ADC system. However, timing mismatch in the TIADC system degrades the spurious-free dynamic range (SFDR) of the TIADC system greatly. In this paper, a blind calibration algorithm based on cross correlation and polynomial regression is proposed, which can estimate and calibrate the timing mismatch blindly. The proposed algorithm needs no extra circuits and no training signals, it can dynamically track the changes of timing mismatch. Simulation and a 130MS/s two-channel TIADC prototype are used to verify the proposed algorithm. The improvement of SFDR is 15dB in average in the frequency band of [0.1 π, 0.8 π]. The simulation and experiment results show that the proposed algorithm has improved the performance of TIADC system effectively.

articleTitle: Performance test of laser power meter verification system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aimed at the requirements of laser equipment, a verification system of laser power meter is established. The system can realize the verification and calibration of laser power meter with wavelength of 532nm, 633nm, 1064nm and power measurement range of 0.1mW to 20W. The relative expanded uncertainty of the system reaches 2% (k=2). The composition and working principle of the system are described in detail. The test methods and measurement data are given for the main parameters of system performance test, such as power stability of laser, power monitoring ratio stability of laser power beam splitter monitoring and correcting device, correction factor of standard laser power meter. After the system test, the performance of the laser power meter verification system has been more perfectly examined.

articleTitle: Adaptive SVD de-noising method based on information entropy and application
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Wind turbine vibration signal is disturbed by noise, which seriously affects the subsequent fault diagnosis of the turbine. The existing de-noising methods have problems like de-noising principle not clear, operation not easy to carry out, and the de-noising effect not obvious. An adaptive SVD de-noising method based on entropy is put forward. Principle of adaptive SVD de-noising is analyzed, and two main methods of high dimension reconstruction are compared; High dimensional Hankel matrix is reconstructed according to the parity of length time series and the inequality principle and second order difference spectrum of information entropy is proposed to determine de-noising order. The proposed SVD de-noising method is applied in noise analysis of wind turbine vibration signals with comparison to three other SVD de-noising methods. Results show that the second order difference spectrum of information entropy SVD de-noising method has better smoothness, and it is capable to highlight the useful part of the signal, and achieves de-noising purpose effectively. The proposed de-noising method can provide reliable data basis for further fault diagnosis of turbines.
