articleTitle: Sensitivity study of a polarization imaging-based target detection system
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Polarization detection has become a useful complement to traditional optical detection techniques because of its robustness to ambient disturbances. However the uncertainties of sensitive factors such as observation geometry and imaging band limit the practical use of polarization imaging in target detection. To study its sensitivity, two target detection experiments of stealth and camouflage tank models under sand and grass background are conducted. Results show that, the Q component calculated by the differential operation of 0° and 90° polarized images provides the largest polarization contrast between target and background than other components. Finally the optimal configuration of polarization imaging-based target detection system is determined and verified by measuring polarization contrast of Q component under different azimuth and inclination of light source and camera, as well as four imaging bands within visible spectrum.

articleTitle: Image enhancement algorithm of Dongba manuscripts based on wavelet analysis and grey relational theory
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Image enhancement is an important part of the image processing of Dongba manuscripts. For the low-contrast and fuzzy Dongba manuscripts image, in this paper, an image enhancement algorithm based on wavelet analysis and grey relational analysis is proposed. Firstly, the wavelet transform is used to decompose the Dongba manuscripts image into three levels, and the corresponding low-frequency components and high-frequency components are obtained. Then, the interference signal and the useful signal in the high frequency component are distinguished by the grey relation analysis theory. Finally, inverse wavelet transformation is used to reconstruct the image so that the contrast enhancement and background suppression can be achieved. The experimental results show that compared with the conventional filtering method and wavelet threshold denoising enhancement method, the proposed method has the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio, suppresses the noise while enhancing the image details and improving the image contrast.

articleTitle: Status and development of MPM
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: MPM realizes the combination of solid-state power devices and vacuum electronic devices and has both advantages, widely used in military and commercial fields such as radar, electronic countermeasures, active bait, phased array and space communication. MPM module consists of three parts: 1) broadband, miniaturized vacuum power amplifier TWT (VPB TWT), the final amplifier of MPM module; 2) broadband, low noise microwave solid-state amplifier (SSA), pre-amplifier of VPB TWT;3) miniaturized, high-power integrated high-voltage power supply (IPC), and power supply which providing all the high and low voltage to VPB TWT, SSA and module monitoring. By properly distributing the gain between SSA and VPB TWT, MPM has both merit of the vacuum electronics and the solid-state devices. In the United States, 1991 MPM project formally implemented, then unique performance and superior performance of MPM attracted worldwide attention, and Europe and Japan have also launched active MPM and VPB TWT research programs with the same goals as those of the United States. After nearly three decades of development, the company's MPM products of Europe and the United States get miniaturized, serialized, modular, and its reliability was further optimized. Its development trend can be summarized as the following four points. miniaturization, the MPM parts need to be effectively integrated within a structure. Miniaturized TWT, the slow wave system manufacturing process must be replaced. To reduce the length of TWT, it is necessary to reduce the gain of TWT. The loss gain requires a solid state amplifier to compensate. Miniaturized SSA, combined with MMIC and microwave integrated technology, using high-density packaging technology, the researchers developed highly integrated microwave solid-state amplifier, to achieve the TWT excitation, equalization and phase shift and other functions. Miniaturized high-voltage power supply, the development of integrated power supply, especially enormous the power of the volume and stability of integrated power supply, is important to the development of MPM. Compared to the traditional linear power supply, integrated power supply greatly reduces its complexity, size, weight and cost.

articleTitle: Acquisition of the optimum X-ray source based on multi-objective optimization model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: To achieve on-site calibration of dose instruments, a calibration transmission system about `National standard metering station-Secondary standards laboratory-Position y monitor calibration' aiming at environmental dose monitoring instrument is established using filtered X-rays. In order to obtain X-ray filtered spectrum of different dose rates, properties of original spectrum with 95 kV high voltage is simulated in Geant4, and the attenuation characteristics of signal material is analyzed, on this basis, multi-objective optimization model is established for various materials, the optimum filtering condition is gotten through solving model. Finally the results of the model are verified through experiment, and it meets the national standard requirement for filtered X-ray resource. This method has significant practical value for obtaining specific doses of X-ray filtered spectrum quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Design of 6 degree-of-freedom micro-positioning mechanism for optical elements
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: For requirements of high-precision displacement compensation of components in optical system, a 6 degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) displacement adjustment mechanism is presented in this paper. The composition and working principle of the mechanism are expatiated. The output compliance and the input stiffness model of the mechanism are established. The results obtained by the finite element analysis (FEA) are compared with that got by the compliance matrix method (CMM). The displacement Jacobian matrix of the mechanism is established according to the FEA results. The output compliance obtained by the FEA and the CMM are 16.081um/N and 14.138 um/N, respectively, and the deviation is 12.083%. The input stiffness got by the FEA and the CMM are 22.483 N/um and 22.127 N/um respectively, and the deviation is 1.605%. The FEA results show that the translation and rotation stroke of the mechanism are larger than 50 um and 200 urad, respectively. The maximum stress on the mechanism is less than 50 MPa when the full stroke is reached. The surface figure introduced by adjusting the lens element is less than 1nm. The results show that the method is feasible and provides the design basis for 6-DOF optical elements.

articleTitle: Characteristics of electrical matching for power piezoelectric transducer
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The characteristics of the electrical matching are the key issues for the applications of the power piezoelectric transducer. This paper proposed a method to evaluate the electrical mismatch between the transducer and the driving signal source, which used an electrical matching circuit with the combination of both the transformer and inductance-capacitance. The characteristics of the electrical matching circuit have been carefully examined by the effects of series inductor, total power and operating frequency on the reflected power. The results show that the designed circuit has a good suitability with changing the value of the series inductor. Moreover, the actual center frequency of the transducer is lower than the tested resonance frequency (50.18 kHz), and it declined from 49.20 kHz to 48.93 kHz with increasing the total power from 8 W to 40 W. The results demonstrate the closely relationships of the reflected power with the series inductor, total power, and operating frequency. This work can provide an experimental reference for applications of the electrical matching circuit for power piezoelectric transducer.

articleTitle: Study on impact effects of electronic system based on working conditions
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, according to the usual finite element modeling methods for PCB (printed circuit boards), the finite element model was created based on Launch Work Conditions, and the effects of three kinds of launch work condition were analyzed compared with the experiment result of the launch under different work conditions. It could be found that PCB has different dynamic effects. Valid work condition in strength test can help to reduce the consuming number of cannonballs. In this way, quantitative evaluation of impact effects electronic system of cannon can be done directly.

articleTitle: A rolling CRC based HDMI function testing method design
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Cyclic redundancy check (CRC) plays a significant role in enhancing the safety and reliability of data transmission. To improve the check capacity of CRC, a rolling CRC algorithm that generates check data using two generator polynomials is proposed, which can eliminate the previous defects of high failure rate and resource consumption. Being applied in the test on high definition multimedia interface (HDMI), the result of implementation of the field programmable gate array (FPGA) shows that new algorithm can improve the check capacity on the basis of low logic complexity and thus ensure more reliable HDMI test. Experiments show that this algorithm is more effective and highly capable of detecting errors.

articleTitle: Stability and influence evaluation of calibrating pyrgeometers outdoors with different pyrgeometer coefficients
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Pyrgeometer is an instrument used for measuring longwave radiation from the Earth's atmosphere and surface. In this article, four pyrgeometers calibrated with a standard pyrgeometer in 2015 and 2016 are analyzed, the net longwave radiation and sensitivities are calculated, we set the sensitivities of these four pyrgeometers retrieved in the calibration of 2013 as the reference, then stabilities of these pyrgeometers are evaluated, only the non-stability of one CGR4 pyrgeometer is up to 1.9%, while the rest are all within 1%. Then the pyrgeometer coefficients k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>=0.058 and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>=0.9993 obtained from low-temperature blackbody and approximate values of k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>=0 and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>=1 are used to calculate the net longwave radiation for a CG4 pyrgeometer using the data collected in 2016 calibration, different k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and k<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> lead to different net longwave radiations, the corresponding sensitivities are compared and show a non-negligible bias of 7.1%.

articleTitle: Biomedical signal processing with time-varying CML model
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Brain electrical signals, one of the typical biomedical signals, is accepted to be produced by the nonlinear dynamic system. In brain electrical signal, both EEG and ERP signal is consider as chaotic signal. In this paper, a new time variation based coupled map lattice(CML) model is put forward to research the nonlinear character of the ERP signal under specified tasks. To further investigate the ERP model and discover new information, the time variation largest Lyapunov exponent (LLE) is developed. Both simulated EEG and acquired ERP experiments were used to test. And the results show that the brain chaos changes corresponding to the changes of attention task. There is an optimum scopes size of cues in the visual attention information processing.

Author Keywords: time variation coupled map lattice model

articleTitle: Study on frequency response of accumulation weighing process
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Quick and accurate weighing system for continuous conveyed materials is important to most of continuous production manufacturing process, especially granular bulk materials. In order to improve weighing speed and precision of this kind of weighing process, the dynamic characteristics of this process was studied in this paper. A model of accumulator in weighing system was presented, and then an exact expression of the frequency response based on an eighteen-sample accumulator in weighing system was discussed in detail, which includes that the parameters can be used to compute the frequency response of the process and so on. By modeling exact frequency response of this process, which can allow us to make a better estimate of the digital filtering that is required to satisfy a given vibration rejection requirement for better precision and faster response speed. The methods of derivation in the paper may be used to obtain similar formulas in different weighing process.

articleTitle: A time interval measuring technique with high speed and high resolution
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The high resolution time interval measuring technique is widely applied in various areas such as electronic instrument, laser ranging, and physical experiment and so on. The traditional time-to-amplitude conversion-based (TAC) measuring circuit features the high time measuring resolution. However, the measuring speed is low and the measuring result is sensitive to the temperature. This paper firstly analyzes the basic principle of the existing TAC circuit, deduces the mathematical model and indicates the reason of low measuring speed. Based on these, this paper proposes a new TAC circuit based on dual constant-current source (CCS) structure. The error sources that influence the time interval measurement in this TAC circuit based on dual CCS structure are analyzed in detail and the calibration method is presented. The test result shows that the TAC circuit based on dual CCS structure features not only the high measuring accuracy, but also the high measuring speed.

articleTitle: QT-based car navigation map realization and optimization
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the navigation map operation time occupies more resources in the embedded system. In this paper, by studying the digital map of MIF format, the corresponding map is drawn and the map is optimized. Using the GPS module to locate and use the Dijiestra algorithm to achieve the shortest path of the navigation module design, the use of the map database to remove the corresponding area of the data mapping map information, in a translation to a certain distance when the scene clear the data, Draw a map. So there will be no data left in the view. Since the Dijiestra algorithm is based on the graph, it is necessary to link the roads in the area to create an undirected graph to find the shortest path to the end point. If the point of the line as an undirected node, the composition of the undirected map will be very large. And the use of the line as an undirected node, you can reduce the number of nodes without the map, to improve the efficiency of Dijie Stella algorithm traversal. Based on the open system platform and data standard, this paper designs and develops a secure, stable and low cost embedded GPS navigation and navigation system. The experimental results are optimized.

articleTitle: Research on image acquisition and preprocessing method for visual measurement of pipeline inner surface corrosion
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: According to the special background and actual demand of pipeline internal corrosion measurement, this paper designs the hardware system of pipeline internal surface corrosion image acquisition based on binocular vision, and re-optimizes the design of the original hardware platform. In order to meet the requirements of subsequent feature extraction, stereo matching and 3D reconstruction for image quality, The emphasis is to study image preprocessing method. This paper adopts adaptive median filtering method to remove image noise, histogram equalization and histogram normalization method to balance the luminance difference of the details, through image sharpening to enhance the details of the image and the edge of the image, so that the blurred image becomes clearer, to achieve the desired function.

articleTitle: A novel carrier synchronization structure using reduced constellation for 32/64APSK
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper proposes a carrier synchronization structure for 32/64APSK, which is suitable for non-linear satellite communication systems. Different from conventional standalone algorithm structure for 32/64APSK, the proposed carrier synchronization structure consists of a feedback loop by combining reduced constellation with non-data-aided and decision directed (NDA/DD) algorithm. Specifically, amplitude judgement and reduced constellation (AJRC) is constructed and reduces implementation complexity for subsequent error estimates. Finally, a series of simulation analysis are given and it proves the validity of the proposed carrier synchronization structure for 32/64APSK. Further, we implement this architecture on an existing hardware platform, which illustrates the practical value of the proposed structure.

articleTitle: Security strategy and application of the life-cycle cloud platform of electric energy metering equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The coordinated management of the measurement equipment in life-cycle is the essential condition for its quality improvement and stable operation. Considering the present situation that each stage data of the electric energy metering equipment life cycle is isolated, a scheme of the life-cycle management for the electric energy metering equipment is designed, which established ten stages of the equipment life cycle from R & D to worthless in use. According to the management and use of each stage data, the design scheme of the life-cycle cloud platform of the electric energy metering equipment based on composite cloud structure is proposed. Meanwhile, the security policy of the cloud platform, which covers three levels of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS, is formulated to achieve efficient and secure data transfer in multiparty data interaction mode. Then the application of cloud platform is studied, especially on the intelligent manufacturing and supervision, intelligent warehouse management in the whole industry chain and the equipment operation state evaluation, to provide support for quality improvement of electric energy metering equipment and reliable operation of metering business.

articleTitle: Design method of automatic calibration software based on intelligent fitting
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: High correlation and accuracy of multiple calibration parameters make the process of the instrument calibration very complicated. Therefore, this paper presents an automatic calibration method based on intelligent fitting of the data set. The calibration software is designed to integrate instrument control, data processing and calibration file generation by the proposed method. A piecewise linear model between calibration parameters and its influencing factors is established based on the M5' algorithm. The model is used to analyze the test data and calculate the fitting coefficient of the related parameters. It not only reduces the complexity of the multiple parameters correlation, but also improves the calibration efficiency and accuracy. Additionally, the method makes the software independent of the instrument resource by separating the calibration process and software.

articleTitle: A scale adaptive compressed object tracking algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of compressive tracking algorithm which cannot adapt to the scale change in object tracking, a scale adaptive compressed object tracking algorithm is proposed. Firstly, we extract the low-dimensional gray and texture features of the target and its surrounding region by sparse measurement matrix which reduces the complexity of compute. Then the tracking task is formulated as a binary classification via support vector machine (SVM) classifier with online update in the compressed domain. Meanwhile, we utilize the classifier to obtain the target's position in new frame. In addition, we build the hamming distance between hash values of current target and original one to match the template to achieve adaptive template size. Numerous experimental results show the proposed algorithm can keep tracking effectively when the tracked object is under the situation of scale variation and illumination change.

articleTitle: The design and experimental verification of neutron dosimeter
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The energy response function of neutron dosimeter is directly related to the accuracy of its dose monitoring value. Simulation using Monte Carlo software is an effective method to determine the energy response function of neutron dosimeter. Based on the Monte Carlo calculation results, the structure of two kinds of neutron dosimeters suitable for environmental monitoring and radiation field monitoring are determined. The characteristics of high voltage curve and n-γ resolution of the dosimeters are studied experimentally. The experiments are carried out under the single energy neutron source which is generated by accelerator. The experimental results are in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Real-time S-scan imaging reconstruction for ultrasonic phase array based on CORDIC and sectorial interpolation algorithms
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the sectorial scan (S-scan) view of the ultrasound phase array system, the echo data produced from the ultrasonic sensors usually are acquired in the polar coordinates, but need to be displayed in the Cartesian coordinates, which can then realize image reconstruction with pixel filling technology. To effectively perform coordinate conversion and improve the smooth and detailed regions of the ultrasonic S-scan image, herein we propose an algorithm of performing coordinate conversion with the interpolation by using the Radix4-CORDIC and sectorial interpolation technology. The algorithm is validated according to the implementation of FPGA technology, and the results demonstrate the algorithm has good real-time performance and can greatly improve the quality of the S-scan image.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics analysis of planetary gear systemin large-scale wind power generation equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The gears in large-scale wind power generation equipment are prone to crack over the years. Objected to the planetary gear transmission system in large-scale wind power generation equipment, considering the gear backlash, synthetic meshing error, damping and time-varying meshing stiffness, a nonlinear transverse-torsional coupled model was established. With the help of phase plane diagrams and the time history diagrams, continues analysis of the relationship between the kinematic response and the meshing frequency is carried out. And the numerical simulation results showed that as the meshing frequency is changed from small value to large value, the motion states of the system are changed from the stable single periodic motion to the chaotic motion within a certain range. In order to verify the results of simulation, we conducted an experimental study on a real gearbox. The analysis results of simulation and experimental study were consistent. The research results would have theoretical guidance value for the fault diagnosis in engineering.

articleTitle: The image enhancement of forward vehicle video based on catenary semantics
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In view of the complexity of existing image enhancement methods, which can not highlight the detection target, this paper proposes a forward vehicle image enhancement method based on the semantics. This method includes two parts: semantic-based catenary contour extraction and visual enhancement. To extract the catenary semantics contour, the classification model of the catenary and the background patches is trained by the catenary edge detection network. The classification model of the railway image is extracted and classified by the trained classification model, and the confidence level graph of the catenary is obtained by template matching. To achieve visual enhancement of catenary semantics, according to the AlphaBend hybrid method, the catenary confidence level graph is merged with the original image to realize the visual enhancement of the catenary semantics. In this paper, the contour extraction and visual enhancement of the catenary in the railway image are realized, and the gray histogram distribution is more evenly distributed. The number of pixels in each gray level is more average. The average difference and the standard deviation difference between the enhanced catenary area and the background area is greater, and the peak noise ratio and the structural similarity are improved. Comparing with other methods shows that the method in this paper is effective. What's more, it can be more intuitive for the railway staff to show the abnormal situation of the catenary and has very strong practical significance.

articleTitle: Design of low-power field wireless sensor nodes
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems that ever wireless sensor nodes' energy consumption is high and solar-powered wireless nodes are greatly influenced by the weather and the system is not stable, comprehensive utilization of solar energy power supply technology, sensor technology and wireless communication technology, this paper designs a new type of wireless sensor nodes, which is powered by solar energy. The wireless sensor nodes which is supplied by solar energy, solving the problem of the energy consumption of sensor nodes effectively. After tested, it has simple operation, high reliability and it can satisfy the requirement of environmental parameter acquisition and monitoring work.

articleTitle: Robust time delay estimation based on asinh transform under α-stable noises
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: α-stable distribution is a sort of non-Gaussian random distribution and is widely applied to radar, sonar, atmosphere and biomedicine process field and so on. The salient feature of these random signals or noises are that the spike pulse is more significant than conventional Gaussian signal or noise. When dealing with non-Gaussian noises, the time delay algorithm using fractional lower order covariance (FLOC) can achieve better results, but it requests usually the previous estimation of characteristic exponent. In this paper, an adaptive time delay estimation algorithm using asinh transform is proposed. Compare with FLOC algorithm, the new aproach doesn't need the previous estimation of characteristic exponent, through changing the signal into a Gaussian with inverse hyperbolic sine transform under α-stable distributed noise condition, the new method can reliably converge and has got a good estimated precision.

articleTitle: Research on imaging method of magneto-acoustic microscopy based on acousticlens
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Magneto-acoustic tomography (MAT) is a new electrical impedance tomography(EIT), which combines high contrast of EIT and high resolution of ultrasonic imaging. At present, image reconstruction algorithm of MAT mainly include filter back projection algorithm and reconstruction algorithm based on potential function. Although these traditional algorithm avoid the diffraction effect of sound waves, but they all have a common shortcomings, the target sample must be scanned for a circle to achieve accurate imaging. It takes a long time to achieve real-time imaging. The research of microscopic tomography technique based on the difference of electrical characteristics is vital for the study of micro structure of organizations and material. A new magnetic acoustic tomography based on acoustic lens was proposed in this paper. We carried out an in-depth study of the theory of excitation and detection through theoretical and experimental methods. The new reconstruction algorithm was deduced and confirmed the new method could improve the imaging speed. The new method inherits the merit of high resolution, high sensitivity, and fast imaging speed. The new method could form a new functional imaging technology are urgently needed in the scientific research of animals.

articleTitle: Research on mechanics modeling and factors analysis of flexible material R2R machining deformation
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Roll-to-Roll (R2R) processing object is a kind of anisotropic flexible film material, in R2R machining manufacturing equipment subjected to external disturbances or changes in its performance which will have a bearing on deformation of those flexible films, material prone to fold, interlayer slip, damage and other quality problems. In this paper, structure model of R2R manufacturing system of flexible material is established, dynamic analysis of each module is carried out, tension expression equation is deduced, and effect of tension in the system is analyzed by finite element simulation. Analysis shows that change of volume diameter directly causes change of coils' mass and moment and inertia so on to influence tension fluctuation of coils', secondly. Smaller linear velocity of rolls can cause tension to fluctuate significantly, tension of flexible material and its elastic deformation are proportional to the integral value of transmission process, finally under the action of tension, maximum deformation of guide roller occurs at the middle of the roller shaft and gradually decreases toward both sides, and the deformation value increases with the increase of the tension.

articleTitle: Research on mathematical model of electrode boiler based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of controlling the peaking control of the electrode boilers in the “Three North” area (northeast, northwest and north) in China, the power supply of the electrode boiler with BP neural network and Bayesian regularized neural network is put forward Switch active power and main steam temperature modeling prediction method. Based on a 20MW electrode boiler in a power plant in northeast China firstly, the input function of the network was determined by the correlation function method. Then, the BP neural network and the Bayesian neural network were used to establish the electrod boiler model. Finally, the model prediction results were obtained. The results show that the error of Bayesian neural network is smaller than that of BP neural network, and it is more suitable for the peak-load control of electrode type boiler.

articleTitle: Test technology study on operational suitability of portable photoelectric reconnaissance equipment
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: With the change of war mode and battle modality, for assessing capacity of weapon system under the condition of similar war circumstance, traditional performance test is changed to operational test. In the paper, roundly analyses key elements of operational suitability test, establishes index system of operational suitability test on AHP method, constructs evaluation method of operational suitability test based on AHP and Fuzzy Synthesis, applies above method to one portable infrared imaging device test satisfactorily finishes the test task and acquires good test result.

articleTitle: Research and design of monitoring and early warning system for agricultural meteorological element in greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Select the ATmega128 microcontroller as the master chip, a low-cost, full functional, esay-using, early warning system for monitoring the greenhouse agricultural meteorological elements is developed, which is flexible and practicable for both monitoring and warning the environmental temperature and humidity and other elements in greenhouse. In the range of 0 °C- 50 °C, the resolutions of air temperature and ground temperature are both higher than 0.1 °C, the accuracy is better than 0.5 °C. In the range of 0 °C-50 °C, the air humidity resolution can up to1%, the accuracy is6%when the air humidity≤ 80%, while the accuracy is 9%owhenthe air humidity ≥ 80%. The system can collect the meteorological elements of greenhouse in a high density, at the same time, all measurements are under the automatic real-time monitoring, if the value exceeds the normal range set in advance, the system will alarm which will alert the manual intervention to guarantee the good growth of crops in the greenhouse.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Beidou anti-jamming antenna
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: This paper introduces the realization method of Beidou anti-jamming antenna hardware and software, theory analysis and MATLAB simulation of antenna array and adaptive algorithm. The space time joint anti-jamming algorithm based on the linear constraint minimum variance criterion is adopted as the core of the anti-jamming processor. It is designed and implemented successfully. the anti-jamming ability of the antenna is tested and verified. The antenna has the capability of resisting single jam 75 dB and resisting three jam 60 dB. Finally, the difference between theoretical simulation and practical implementation is analyzed, and future work is prospected.

articleTitle: Application of improved A− algorithm in the 3d virtual roaming
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In the three-dimensional virtual map, using A- algorithm can provide navigation for roaming pathfinding of virtual characters. In view of the problem that A- algorithm produces too many redundant nodes and influences the search efficiency when searching path, A- algorithm improved strategies is proposed from two aspects. In order to avoid blind search to produce redundant nodes, the vector angle was introduced as a reference for priority ranking of nodes with a minimum F value, and firstly searching nodes that with higher priority, when those nodes that with minimum F value are more than one in the OPEN state list; the vector angle was introduced to limit the number of redundant nodes when nodes extend. In this way, redundant nodes which add to OPEN status table could be reduced, the efficiency of the algorithm could be improved obviously. In addition, viewing the problem that the path is not smooth and easy to appear jagged turn, the final path will be smoothed to reduce turning times and the quality of roaming picture is improved. The experimental results show that in the three-dimensional virtual roaming map, the improved A- algorithm can search the feasible and optimal path efficiently and reduce the time of algorithm running and the number of nodes and improve the efficiency of search, while making the paths more smooth.

articleTitle: Development of offset frequency generator based on programmable modulus DDS
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: A novel offset frequency generator is designed and implemented in this paper, which is usually an essential component in a Dual Mixer Time Difference (DMTD) measurement system. The key element of the offset frequency generator is a Direct Digital Synthesizer (DDS) with programmable modulus, which is a modification of the typical accumulator-based DDS architecture and a guarantee of exactly frequency synthesizing. Microcontroller, reconstruction filter and driver amplifier are then implemented to generate the exact output offset frequency. If a Crystal Oscillator MV200 is used as a fixed frequency reference the generator, the relative error of its output frequency is less than 2.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup>. And the concise and reasonable circuit designs contribute to the offset frequency generator short term fractional frequency stability at a level of 3.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> at 1s averaging time. The circuit design and performance of the offset frequency generator proposed in this paper may be taken as technical references for the planning and designing of a low cost, miniaturization, and high accuracy DMTD system.

articleTitle: Phase difference measurement of low-frequency sinusoidal signals based on LabWindows/CVI
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: In this paper, a method of measuring phase difference between low-frequency sinusoidal signals is proposed. The measurement method mainly contains two parts: simultaneous acquisition of sinusoidal signals and digital correlation analysis. And a virtual instrumentation system based on LabWindows/CVI is developed and a phase adjustable dual channel function signal generator is employed in the experiments in order to verify the validity of the measurement method. The experimental results show that the phase difference measurement system has the characteristics of simplicity, convenience and accurate, and the design scheme and performance of the system proposed in this paper may be taken as technical references for the planning and designing of other phase difference measurement systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of the remaining useful life of middle-low speed maglev train braking system based on COA-LSSVR
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: The prediction of remaining useful life has always been the research hotspot in the field of reliability engineering. The structure of the system is too complex to model by the method of physical model and it is also difficult to accurately predict the remaining useful life. During the actual operation process, the equipment maintenance would inevitably lead to the change of the curve, and sometimes the variation of curve is comparatively large. In view of the equipment maintenance situation, the error control advantage of least square support vector regression(LSSVR) could be taken. In this paper, two parameters of LSSVR were optimized by using the cuckoo optimization algorithm (COA), and the COA-LSSVR model was established. Then the model was used to predict the remaining useful life. Based on the experimental data of medium-low speed maglev train braking system, LSSVR was used to compare with COA-LSSVR finally. The results show that the proposed algorithm of COA-LSSVR model could gain more accurate data of the remaining useful life.

articleTitle: Metallic wear particles detection in micro-channel based on resistance signal
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: It is important to monitor and diagnose the working condition of hydraulic equipment in civil industry. The metallic wear particles in hydraulic oil can cause faults of hydraulic system, so it is crucial to check the wear particles in hydraulic oil. Based on electromagnetism theory and resistance measurement principle, a new oil detection chip has been designed. The main detection area of the chip is consisted of a series resonant circuit. The chip has an advantage of achieving the distinction of metallic wear particles by resistance signal measuring, and current detection chip cannot distinguish metallic wear particles by resistance signal measuring. With theoretical derivation and experiment results, the relation between different metallic particles and resistance signal variation was analyzed. The results indicated that when ferromagnetic wear particles pass through the detection area, the resistance signal is positive. And when non-ferromagnetic wear particles pass through the detection area, the resistance signal is negative. By contrast with inductance detection method, the proposed chip has improved the detecting accuracy. It can detect the iron particles with minimum size of 40ßm and the copper particles with minimum size of 100μm can be detected. This study provides a very good research scheme for oil metallic particles detection.

articleTitle: Nonlinear characteristics and pre distortion modeling of a non memory RF power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2017 13th IEEE International Conference on Electronic Measurement & Instruments (ICEMI)
abstract: Power amplifier is an important component of wireless communication transmitter, the nonlinear distortion of the RF power amplifier leads to a new frequency component, thereby causing interference to the transmitted signal, Cause signal distortion and increase of receiver error rate. Therefore, it is necessary to eliminate the nonlinear effects of the amplifier as much as possible. This paper mainly focuses on the power amplifier power amplifier output signal with respect to the nonlinear input signal possible distortion phenomenon research, construct a memory less predistortion mathematical model based on polynomial, the amplifier signal pre distortion compensation processing. And on the basis of the use of Matlab programming to input and output data memory model of the pre distortion compensation processing, the negative impact of the predistortion model processing method can interfere with the power amplifier nonlinear about adjacent channel consumption significantly, significantly improve the linearity of the power amplifier.
